<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="th">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>TECH QUEST - Minimal Adventure</title>
<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+Thai:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');
:root{
 --bg:#f6f5fb;--surface:#fff;--surface-soft:#f1eff9;--surface-tint:#f8f7fc;
 --text:#29263d;--muted:#77748b;--border:#e7e4f0;--primary:#7668df;
 --primary-dark:#5e50c5;--primary-soft:#eeebff;--accent:#a69af6;
 --success:#16835d;--success-soft:#e7f6ef;--danger:#d4516b;--danger-soft:#fff0f2;
 --shadow:0 14px 38px rgba(48,40,88,.08);--radius:22px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;background:radial-gradient(circle at 12% 0%,#efedff 0,transparent 28%),var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:"Noto Sans Thai","Noto Sans",Tahoma,sans-serif;line-height:1.55}
button,input,select{font:inherit}
button{cursor:pointer;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:13px;padding:11px 16px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);font-weight:600;transition:transform .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease,background .18s ease,border-color .18s ease}
button:hover:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(-1px);border-color:#c9c2ed;box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(74,62,145,.09)}
button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #a79df0;outline-offset:2px}
button:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none;box-shadow:none}
input,select{padding:12px 14px;background:#fff;color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;max-width:100%;width:100%}
input::placeholder{color:#a29eb2}
.container{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:22px}
h1,h2,h3,p{margin-top:0}
h1{font-size:clamp(27px,4vw,38px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.6px;color:var(--text);text-align:center}
h2{font-size:clamp(20px,3vw,25px);font-weight:750;color:var(--text);margin-bottom:14px}
h3{font-size:17px;color:var(--text)}
.screen{display:none}
.screen.active{display:block}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:clamp(18px,3vw,28px);margin:16px 0;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.hidden{display:none!important}
.muted,.codex-note,.knowledge-muted{color:var(--muted)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr));gap:13px}
.stat{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;min-height:92px;padding:16px;background:var(--surface-tint);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}
button.stat{width:100%}
.stat b{display:block;color:var(--primary-dark);font-size:23px;font-weight:800}
.main{background:var(--primary);color:#fff;border-color:var(--primary);font-weight:700}
.main:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--primary-dark);border-color:var(--primary-dark)}
.gold{background:var(--primary-soft);color:var(--primary-dark);border-color:#ded9ff;font-weight:700}
.gold:hover:not(:disabled){background:#e5e0ff;border-color:#c9c0ff}
.correct{background:var(--success-soft)!important;color:#116746!important;border-color:#a8dec3!important}
.wrong{background:var(--danger-soft)!important;color:#a7354d!important;border-color:#f0b8c3!important}
.line-icon{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;width:20px;height:20px;vertical-align:middle;color:currentColor}
.line-icon svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.button-icon{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.app-topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;padding:8px 2px 14px}
.brand-lockup{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px}
.brand-mark{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--primary-soft);color:var(--primary);display:grid;place-items:center}
.brand-mark .line-icon{width:24px;height:24px}
.brand-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.2}
.brand-copy strong{font-size:16px;letter-spacing:1.2px}
.brand-copy small{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.5px}
.top-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.top-actions button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.auth-logout{background:#fff;color:#6559b8;border-color:#dcd7f0}
.hero-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:25px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:4px 0 20px}
.hero-wrap>div{max-width:440px}
.hero-art{width:174px;max-height:220px;object-fit:contain;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;background:#f0eff8;box-shadow:0 10px 25px rgba(45,37,90,.1)}
.home-actions{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:20px}
.home-actions button,.home-actions .backup-label{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.backup-label{padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:13px;background:var(--surface);font-weight:600;color:var(--text);cursor:pointer}
.backup-label input{width:auto;max-width:180px;border:0;padding:2px;background:transparent}
#saveStatus{margin:16px 0 0;font-size:12px}
.tower-banner{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:15px 18px;margin:14px 0 20px;background:var(--surface-soft);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;color:var(--primary-dark);font-weight:650}
.tower-banner .line-icon{color:var(--primary)}
.map-form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin:18px 0}
.map-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:650;color:var(--muted)}
.map-field input,.map-field select{font-weight:400;color:var(--text)}
#difficultyProgress{grid-column:1/-1;margin:0}
#stages{margin-top:18px}
.stage-card{align-items:flex-start;text-align:left;min-height:142px;gap:8px;padding:15px}
.stage-card b{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--primary-dark);font-size:15px}
.stage-card .stage-enemy-label,.stage-card .stage-state{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}
.stage-card .stage-state{margin-top:auto;color:var(--primary-dark);font-weight:700}
#game{padding:clamp(16px,3vw,26px)}
.game-hud{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:12px}
.stage-meta{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}
.stage-meta small{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.7px}
#stageTitle{font-weight:750;font-size:16px}
.game-stats{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.hud-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:8px 12px;background:var(--surface-soft);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.hud-chip b{color:var(--text);font-size:16px}
#time{min-width:20px;text-align:center}
.bar{height:9px;background:#eceaf3;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
.bar div{height:100%;width:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9d91f0,var(--primary));border-radius:99px;transition:width .3s ease}
#timebar{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9e92f1,#7668df)}
#progress{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin:12px 0 5px}
.hp-display{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:8px 0 14px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.hp-pips{display:flex;gap:5px}
.hp-pip{width:23px;height:8px;border-radius:20px;background:#e7e4ef}
.hp-pip.filled{background:#8c7fe8}
.hp-count{font-weight:700;color:var(--text)}
.battle-panel{padding:16px 18px;margin:12px 0 16px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#faf9ff,#f0eef9)}
.battle-stage{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(12px,4vw,42px);min-height:176px}
.actor{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;min-width:115px;transition:transform .2s ease}
.actor-sprite-frame{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;width:126px;height:132px;overflow:visible}
.actor-sprite-frame img{display:block;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 8px rgba(50,43,91,.16))}
.actor-player .actor-sprite-frame{border-radius:18px}
.actor-name{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);text-align:center}
.battle-vs{width:34px;height:34px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.5px}
.actor-idle .actor-sprite-frame{animation:idleFloat 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.actor-walk.actor-player{animation:walkPlayer .85s ease-in-out 1}
.actor-walk.actor-enemy{animation:walkEnemy .85s ease-in-out 1}
.actor-walk .actor-sprite-frame{animation:walkBounce .85s ease-in-out 1}
.actor-attack.actor-player .actor-sprite-frame{animation:attackPlayer .56s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) 1}
.actor-attack.actor-enemy .actor-sprite-frame{animation:attackEnemy .56s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) 1}
.actor-hurt .actor-sprite-frame{animation:actorHurt .48s ease-out 1}
.actor-attack::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:28px;right:-4px;width:48px;height:48px;border:3px solid transparent;border-top-color:#8e80ef;border-right-color:#8e80ef;border-radius:50%;opacity:0;transform:rotate(-35deg);animation:slashBurst .5s ease-out 1;pointer-events:none}
.actor-enemy.actor-attack::after{left:-4px;right:auto;transform:scaleX(-1) rotate(-35deg);border-top-color:#d77b91;border-right-color:#d77b91}
.actor-hurt{filter:saturate(.65)}
.enemy-health{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:7px;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.enemy-health .bar{flex:1}
#enemyBar{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#df8ca1,#cf5876)!important}
#enemyDesc{text-align:center;font-size:12px;margin:5px 0 10px}
.skill-panel{background:var(--surface-tint);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;padding:15px;margin:14px 0}
.skill-panel>strong{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:var(--text);margin:0 0 10px;font-size:14px}
.skill-panel button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:4px;padding:10px 12px;background:#fff}
.skill-panel button small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;font-weight:400}
.skill-label{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.skill-panel button:disabled{opacity:.42}
#skillStatus{font-size:11px;margin:9px 3px 0}
#question{font-size:clamp(18px,2.7vw,23px);line-height:1.55;margin:18px 0;padding:17px 18px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--surface-soft);border:1px solid var(--border)}
#answers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}
.answer{display:block;width:100%;text-align:left;margin:0;padding:13px 15px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:13px;line-height:1.5}
.answer:disabled{opacity:1;cursor:default}
#feedback{min-height:25px;margin:12px 2px;font-size:13px}
#next{margin:4px 6px 4px 0}
#result{text-align:center}
.result-symbol{width:76px;height:76px;display:grid;place-items:center;margin:0 auto 12px;border-radius:24px;background:var(--primary-soft);color:var(--primary)}
.result-symbol .line-icon{width:38px;height:38px}
#resultTitle{margin-bottom:8px}
#resultText{color:var(--muted)}
.perk-panel-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
#perkCountdown{font-size:24px;color:var(--primary-dark);font-weight:800}
.perk-option{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;text-align:left;margin:8px 0;padding:13px 15px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:#fff}
.perk-option.selected{border-color:var(--primary);background:var(--primary-soft);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #7668df16}
.perk-option .line-icon{color:var(--primary)}
.perk-option small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:400}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden}
td,th{padding:12px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);text-align:left}
th{background:var(--surface-soft);color:var(--primary-dark);font-size:12px}
td{font-size:13px}
.codex-img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;margin:12px 0 20px;background:var(--surface-soft)}
.codex-note{font-size:13px}
.section-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin:18px 0 7px;color:var(--primary-dark)}
.section-title .line-icon{width:22px;height:22px}
.knowledge-toolbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin:14px 0}
.search-wrap{position:relative}
.search-wrap>.line-icon{position:absolute;left:13px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:var(--muted)}
.search-wrap input{padding-left:42px}
.knowledge-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:15px;padding:15px;margin:10px 0}
.knowledge-card h3{margin:8px 0;color:var(--text)}
.knowledge-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:var(--surface-soft);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;padding:4px 9px;font-size:11px;color:var(--primary-dark)}
.knowledge-tag .line-icon{width:14px;height:14px}
.knowledge-answer{color:var(--success);font-weight:700}.wrong-answer{color:var(--danger);font-weight:600}
.knowledge-muted{font-size:12px}
.knowledge-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:10px 0}
.knowledge-actions button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:13px}
.admin-intro{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#faf9ff,#f0eef9);margin:12px 0 16px}
.admin-intro p{margin:5px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.6}
.admin-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--primary-soft);color:var(--primary-dark);font-size:11px;font-weight:800}
.admin-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin:14px 0}
.admin-stat{padding:14px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;background:#fff;min-width:0}
.admin-stat b{display:block;font-size:25px;color:var(--primary-dark);line-height:1.2}
.admin-stat span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.admin-toolbar{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:14px 0}
.admin-toolbar input{flex:1;min-width:180px}
.admin-table-wrap{overflow-x:auto;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;margin:12px 0}
.admin-table-wrap table{min-width:620px}
.admin-role{display:inline-flex;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--surface-soft);font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.admin-role.is-admin{background:var(--primary-soft);color:var(--primary-dark)}
.admin-actions{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.admin-actions button{padding:7px 9px;font-size:11px}
.admin-note{padding:12px 14px;background:#fff9e9;border:1px solid #f0dfb2;border-radius:12px;color:#78602b;font-size:12px;line-height:1.65;margin:14px 0}
.admin-empty{padding:22px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);border:1px dashed var(--border);border-radius:14px}
.admin-danger{border-color:#e9b8c2!important;color:#a83e59!important}
@media(max-width:680px){.admin-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.admin-intro{padding:13px}}
.auth-screen{max-width:980px;margin:18px auto;padding:0!important;overflow:hidden;background:#fff!important;color:var(--text)!important;border:1px solid var(--border)!important;border-radius:26px!important;box-shadow:0 22px 60px rgba(49,40,93,.12)}
.auth-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;min-height:570px}
.auth-side{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#9185ed,#695bd1);color:#fff;padding:42px 34px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;text-align:center}
.auth-logo{width:82px;height:82px;border-radius:24px;background:#fff;color:var(--primary);display:grid;place-items:center;margin-bottom:18px;box-shadow:0 12px 28px #4034a533}
.auth-logo-mark{font-size:25px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px}
.auth-side h1{font-size:31px;letter-spacing:1.8px;margin:8px 0;color:#fff}
.auth-side p{color:#f0eeff;line-height:1.7;max-width:280px;font-size:14px}
.auth-side .auth-caption{margin-top:48px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2.5px;font-weight:700;color:#e7e3ff}
.auth-panel{padding:48px clamp(22px,5vw,64px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;background:#fcfbff}
.auth-panel h2{color:var(--text);font-size:28px;margin:0 0 8px}
.auth-sub{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 24px;font-size:13px}
.auth-form{display:none}
.auth-form.active{display:block}
.auth-field{display:block;margin:13px 0;color:#55516c;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.auth-field input{width:100%;max-width:none;margin-top:7px;padding:13px 14px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:11px;background:#fff;color:var(--text);outline:none}
.auth-field input:focus{border-color:var(--primary);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #8172e51b}
.auth-submit{width:100%;border:0;border-radius:11px;padding:14px;background:var(--primary);color:#fff;font-weight:700;margin:12px 0 8px}
.auth-submit:hover{background:var(--primary-dark)}
.auth-switch{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin:15px 0}
.auth-link{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--primary-dark);padding:4px 6px;font-weight:800;box-shadow:none}
.auth-link:hover{background:var(--primary-soft);box-shadow:none}
.auth-message{min-height:22px;color:#b23c58;font-size:12px;margin:5px 0}
.auth-message.ok{color:var(--success)}
.auth-divider{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:#aaa6bb;font-size:11px;margin:18px 0}
.auth-divider:before,.auth-divider:after{content:"";height:1px;background:var(--border);flex:1}
.auth-note{font-size:10px;color:#9692a5;line-height:1.6;text-align:center;margin-top:20px}
.auth-active .container>.app-topbar{display:none!important}
.auth-active .container>.screen:not(#authScreen){display:none!important}
.auth-active #authScreen{display:block!important}
@keyframes idleFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px)}}
@keyframes walkBounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}25%{transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(-2deg)}50%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(1deg)}75%{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(-1deg)}}
@keyframes walkPlayer{0%{transform:translateX(-10px)}50%{transform:translateX(9px)}100%{transform:translateX(0)}}
@keyframes walkEnemy{0%{transform:translateX(10px)}50%{transform:translateX(-9px)}100%{transform:translateX(0)}}
@keyframes attackPlayer{0%{transform:translateX(0) rotate(0)}35%{transform:translateX(25px) rotate(-7deg) scale(1.05)}65%{transform:translateX(12px) rotate(4deg)}100%{transform:translateX(0) rotate(0)}}
@keyframes attackEnemy{0%{transform:translateX(0) rotate(0)}35%{transform:translateX(-25px) rotate(7deg) scale(1.05)}65%{transform:translateX(-12px) rotate(-4deg)}100%{transform:translateX(0) rotate(0)}}
@keyframes actorHurt{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0);filter:none}20%{transform:translateX(-7px);filter:brightness(1.25) saturate(.6)}40%{transform:translateX(6px)}60%{transform:translateX(-4px);filter:brightness(1.18)}80%{transform:translateX(3px)}}
@keyframes slashBurst{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.5) rotate(-35deg)}35%{opacity:.95;transform:scale(1.15) rotate(5deg)}100%{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.45) rotate(35deg)}}
@media(max-width:680px){
 .container{padding:12px}
 .auth-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:0}
 .auth-side{padding:26px 20px}
 .auth-side .auth-caption{margin-top:12px}
 .auth-logo{width:64px;height:64px;margin-bottom:8px}
 .auth-side h1{font-size:25px}
 .auth-panel{padding:30px 22px}
 .auth-screen{margin:8px auto}
 .map-form{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .knowledge-toolbar{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .battle-stage{min-height:150px;gap:8px}
 .actor{min-width:95px}
 .actor-sprite-frame{width:105px;height:115px}
}
@media(max-width:480px){
 .container{padding:9px}
 .card{padding:15px;border-radius:18px}
 .app-topbar{align-items:flex-start}
 .brand-mark{width:37px;height:37px}
 .brand-copy strong{font-size:14px}
 .top-actions{gap:5px}
 .top-actions button{padding:9px 10px;font-size:12px}
 .hero-art{width:135px;max-height:175px}
 .hero-wrap{gap:12px}
 .home-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
 .home-actions button,.home-actions .backup-label{justify-content:center;font-size:12px;padding:10px 8px}
 .backup-label{flex-wrap:wrap}
 .backup-label input{max-width:100px}
 #answers{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .game-hud{align-items:flex-start}
 .game-stats{width:100%;justify-content:flex-end}
 .battle-panel{padding:12px 8px}
 .actor-sprite-frame{width:90px;height:100px}
 .actor{min-width:82px}
 .battle-vs{width:29px;height:29px}
 .skill-panel button{width:100%;justify-content:flex-start;margin:4px 0}
 td,th{padding:9px 7px;font-size:11px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
 *,*::before,*::after{scroll-behavior:auto!important;animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}
}
#stages{display:block;margin-top:20px}
.world-region{margin:18px 0 26px;padding:16px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f8faff,#f0f4ff)}
.world-region-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}
.world-region-head small{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;font-weight:900;color:#6476bd}
.world-region-head h3{margin:3px 0 0;font-size:18px;color:var(--text)}
.world-region-head>span{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--primary-dark);background:#fff;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:999px}
.world-path{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;position:relative}
.map-node{position:relative;min-width:0;min-height:130px;padding:12px 7px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:6px;border:1px solid #d8def2;border-radius:16px;background:#fff;color:var(--text);text-align:center;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #dfe5f4;transition:transform .16s,box-shadow .16s}
.map-node:not(:disabled):active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 #dfe5f4}
.map-node .node-number{width:38px;height:38px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:12px;background:#e9efff;color:#4056a5;font-weight:900;font-size:14px}
.map-node b{font-size:12px;line-height:1.35}
.map-node small{font-size:10px;line-height:1.3;color:var(--muted);overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.map-node em{margin-top:auto;font-size:10px;font-style:normal;font-weight:800;color:#5064ae}
.map-node.current{border:2px solid #647de0;background:#f2f5ff;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #cbd5fa}
.map-node.current .node-number{background:#526bd0;color:#fff}
.map-node.cleared{border-color:#a7d9c1;background:#f0fff7}
.map-node.cleared .node-number{background:#bdebd2;color:#176b45}
.map-node.cleared em{color:#18764d}
.map-node.locked{opacity:.55;background:#f1f2f5;box-shadow:none}
.map-node.boss-node{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff7ed,#fff0f0);border-color:#efc1b6}
.map-node.boss-node .node-number{background:#ffe0d7;color:#a43f32}
.map-node.boss-node em{color:#a43f32}
.combat-objective{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;margin:12px 0 8px;padding:11px 13px;border:1px solid #dce3ff;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#edf2ff,#f8faff)}
.objective-mark{flex:0 0 auto;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:9px;background:#536bd0;color:white;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1px}
.combat-objective b,.combat-objective small{display:block}
.combat-objective b{font-size:13px}
.combat-objective small{margin-top:2px;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;line-height:1.4}
#question{margin-top:10px}
@media(max-width:620px){
 .world-region{padding:11px;margin:14px 0 20px}
 .world-path{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}
 .map-node{min-height:118px}
 .world-region-head h3{font-size:16px}
 .combat-objective{align-items:flex-start}
}
html,body{width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow-x:hidden}
body{min-width:320px}
.container{width:100%;max-width:1080px;margin-inline:auto}
.container>*{min-width:0}
.card,.screen,.auth-screen,.auth-layout,.auth-panel,.auth-side{min-width:0;max-width:100%}
img,svg,video,canvas{max-width:100%}
input,select,button,textarea{max-width:100%;min-width:0}
.grid,.map-form,#answers,.knowledge-toolbar,.admin-stats{min-width:0}
.grid>* ,.map-form>* ,#answers>* ,.knowledge-toolbar>* ,.admin-stats>*{min-width:0}
button{min-height:42px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
button .line-icon{flex-shrink:0}
.card p,.card h1,.card h2,.card h3,.card label,.card span{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.app-topbar,.top-actions,.game-hud,.game-stats,.admin-toolbar,.home-actions,.knowledge-actions{min-width:0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.app-topbar>* ,.top-actions>* ,.game-hud>* ,.game-stats>*{min-width:0}
.hero-wrap>div{min-width:0;flex:1 1 260px}
.stage-card{min-width:0}
.admin-table-wrap{max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.admin-table-wrap table{min-width:620px}
.screen table{max-width:100%}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .container{padding:12px}
 .card{margin:10px 0;padding:clamp(14px,3.5vw,20px);border-radius:18px}
 .app-topbar{align-items:center;gap:10px}
 .top-actions{justify-content:flex-end}
 .top-actions button{padding:9px 11px}
 .auth-screen{margin:8px auto;border-radius:18px!important}
 .auth-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);min-height:0}
 .auth-side{padding:22px 18px}
 .auth-panel{padding:26px clamp(16px,5vw,28px)}
 .auth-side .auth-caption{margin-top:10px}
 .auth-logo{width:60px;height:60px;margin-bottom:8px}
 .auth-side h1{font-size:clamp(22px,6vw,27px)}
 .auth-panel h2{font-size:clamp(21px,5vw,26px)}
 .map-form,.knowledge-toolbar{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
 .admin-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
 .admin-toolbar{align-items:stretch}
 .admin-toolbar input{min-width:0;flex:1 1 100%}
 .battle-stage{gap:clamp(4px,2vw,12px);min-height:140px}
 .actor{min-width:0;flex:1 1 0}
 .actor-sprite-frame{width:clamp(76px,20vw,110px);height:clamp(82px,23vw,118px)}
 .battle-vs{flex:0 0 30px;width:30px;height:30px}
 .game-stats{justify-content:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}
 .hud-chip{padding:7px 9px;font-size:12px}
 .hud-chip b{font-size:14px}
 .skill-panel{padding:12px}
 .home-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
 .home-actions>*{min-width:0;justify-content:center}
 .backup-label{min-width:0;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center}
 .backup-label input{max-width:100%;width:100%}
}
@media(max-width:420px){
 body{font-size:14px}
 .container{padding:8px}
 .card{padding:13px;border-radius:15px}
 .app-topbar{align-items:flex-start}
 .brand-lockup{gap:8px;min-width:0}
 .brand-copy strong{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.6px}
 .brand-copy small{font-size:10px}
 .brand-mark{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:11px}
 .top-actions{width:100%;justify-content:flex-end}
 .top-actions button{font-size:11px;padding:8px 9px}
 h1{font-size:clamp(23px,7vw,30px)}
 h2{font-size:20px}
 .home-actions{gap:7px}
 .home-actions button,.home-actions .backup-label{font-size:11px;padding:9px 6px}
 #answers{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
 .battle-panel{padding:10px 7px}
 .actor-sprite-frame{width:clamp(66px,19vw,84px);height:clamp(74px,21vw,94px)}
 .actor{font-size:11px}
 .actor-name{font-size:10px}
 .battle-vs{flex-basis:26px;width:26px;height:26px;font-size:9px}
 .admin-stats{gap:7px}
 .admin-stat{padding:10px}
 .admin-stat b{font-size:21px}
 .admin-stat span{font-size:10px}
 .perk-option{align-items:flex-start;padding:11px}
 .auth-panel{padding:22px 15px}
 td,th{padding:8px 7px;font-size:11px}
}
@media(max-width:350px){
 .game-stats{gap:5px}
 .hud-chip{gap:4px;padding:6px 7px;font-size:11px}
 .battle-stage{gap:2px}
 .actor-sprite-frame{width:64px;height:72px}
 .battle-vs{flex-basis:23px;width:23px;height:23px}
}
#deviceModeToggle{position:fixed;right:16px;bottom:16px;z-index:9999;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid #d9d4ef;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);color:#51469f;box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(42,35,88,.18);font-size:13px;font-weight:750;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
#deviceModeToggle .mode-icon{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:20px;height:20px}
#deviceModeToggle svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
body.force-mobile .container{max-width:430px!important;padding:10px!important}
body.force-mobile .auth-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important;min-height:0!important}
body.force-mobile .map-form,body.force-mobile .knowledge-toolbar{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important}
body.force-mobile .admin-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
body.force-mobile .home-actions{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
body.force-mobile #answers{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important}
body.force-mobile .app-topbar{flex-wrap:wrap!important}
body.force-mobile .top-actions{width:100%;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap}
body.force-mobile .game-stats{width:100%;justify-content:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}
body.force-mobile .battle-stage{gap:5px!important}
body.force-mobile .actor{min-width:0!important;flex:1 1 0!important}
body.force-mobile .actor-sprite-frame{width:clamp(64px,19vw,94px)!important;height:clamp(72px,21vw,102px)!important}
body.force-desktop .container{max-width:1080px!important;padding:22px!important}
body.force-desktop .auth-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr)!important;min-height:560px}
body.force-desktop .map-form{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
body.force-desktop .knowledge-toolbar{grid-template-columns:minmax(180px,1fr) minmax(180px,1fr)!important}
body.force-desktop .home-actions{display:flex!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important}
body.force-desktop #answers{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
body.force-desktop .admin-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important}
body.force-desktop .battle-stage{gap:clamp(12px,4vw,42px)!important}
body.force-desktop .actor{min-width:115px!important;flex:initial!important}
body.force-desktop .actor-sprite-frame{width:126px!important;height:132px!important}
@media(max-width:520px){#deviceModeToggle{right:10px;bottom:10px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:12px}}
.dice-result{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin:12px auto 2px;padding:10px 14px;max-width:330px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface-soft);color:var(--text);transition:transform .2s ease,background .2s ease}
.dice-result .dice-cube{display:grid;place-items:center;width:42px;height:42px;flex:0 0 42px;border-radius:11px;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--primary);color:var(--primary-dark);font-size:22px;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--border)}
.dice-result b,.dice-result small{display:block}.dice-result b{font-size:13px}.dice-result small{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
.dice-result.rolling .dice-cube{animation:diceRoll .55s ease-in-out}.dice-result.hit{border-color:#60a879;background:#eaf7ee}.dice-result.hit .dice-cube{border-color:#29945a;color:#187744}.dice-result.critical{border-color:#d5a33a;background:#fff7df}.dice-result.critical .dice-cube{border-color:#d5a33a;color:#9a6900}.dice-result.damage{border-color:#d77b91;background:#fff0f3}.dice-result.damage .dice-cube{border-color:#d77b91;color:#b33f60}
@keyframes diceRoll{0%{transform:translateY(-34px) rotateX(0) rotateY(0) rotateZ(0) scale(.55);opacity:.25}18%{transform:translateY(-18px) rotateX(160deg) rotateY(120deg) rotateZ(95deg) scale(1.25);opacity:1}38%{transform:translateY(5px) rotateX(330deg) rotateY(260deg) rotateZ(210deg) scale(.92)}58%{transform:translateY(-12px) rotateX(510deg) rotateY(410deg) rotateZ(330deg) scale(1.12)}78%{transform:translateY(2px) rotateX(670deg) rotateY(560deg) rotateZ(430deg) scale(.98)}100%{transform:translateY(0) rotateX(720deg) rotateY(720deg) rotateZ(540deg) scale(1);opacity:1}}
.dice-result{perspective:600px;overflow:visible;min-height:66px}
.dice-result .dice-cube{transform-style:preserve-3d;will-change:transform;box-shadow:0 7px 0 var(--border),0 12px 18px rgba(30,25,60,.18)}
.dice-result.rolling .dice-cube{animation:diceRoll 1.15s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1) both}
.actor-sprite-frame img{will-change:transform;transform-origin:50% 85%}
.actor-attack.actor-player .actor-sprite-frame{animation:attackPlayer .72s cubic-bezier(.15,.8,.2,1) 1}
.actor-attack.actor-enemy .actor-sprite-frame{animation:attackEnemy .72s cubic-bezier(.15,.8,.2,1) 1}
.actor-hurt .actor-sprite-frame{animation:actorHurt .62s ease-out 1}
@keyframes attackPlayer{0%{transform:translateX(0) translateY(0) rotate(0) scale(1)}22%{transform:translateX(-9px) translateY(-5px) rotate(-8deg) scale(1.06)}52%{transform:translateX(34px) translateY(-2px) rotate(9deg) scale(1.13)}72%{transform:translateX(20px) translateY(0) rotate(-3deg) scale(1.04)}100%{transform:translateX(0) translateY(0) rotate(0) scale(1)}}
@keyframes attackEnemy{0%{transform:translateX(0) translateY(0) rotate(0) scale(1)}22%{transform:translateX(9px) translateY(-5px) rotate(8deg) scale(1.06)}52%{transform:translateX(-34px) translateY(-2px) rotate(-9deg) scale(1.13)}72%{transform:translateX(-20px) translateY(0) rotate(3deg) scale(1.04)}100%{transform:translateX(0) translateY(0) rotate(0) scale(1)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.dice-result.rolling .dice-cube,.actor-walk .actor-sprite-frame,.actor-attack .actor-sprite-frame,.actor-hurt .actor-sprite-frame{animation:none!important}}
.battle-stage{position:relative;isolation:isolate;overflow:visible}
.actor{z-index:1}
.actor-attack{z-index:4}
.actor-attack.actor-player .actor-sprite-frame{animation:tqPlayerLunge .76s cubic-bezier(.22,.7,.2,1) both}
.actor-attack.actor-enemy .actor-sprite-frame{animation:tqEnemyLunge .76s cubic-bezier(.22,.7,.2,1) both}
.actor-hurt .actor-sprite-frame{animation:tqHitReact .7s steps(6,end) both}
@keyframes tqPlayerLunge{0%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}17%{transform:translate(-12px,5px) scale(.93,1.06)}34%{transform:translate(-7px,-7px) scale(1.05)}55%{transform:translate(68px,-9px) rotate(7deg) scale(1.15)}67%{transform:translate(58px,-3px) rotate(-5deg)}100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}}
@keyframes tqEnemyLunge{0%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}17%{transform:translate(12px,5px) scale(.93,1.06)}34%{transform:translate(7px,-7px) scale(1.05)}55%{transform:translate(-68px,-9px) rotate(-7deg) scale(1.15)}67%{transform:translate(-58px,-3px) rotate(5deg)}100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}}
@keyframes tqHitReact{0%,24%,100%{transform:translateX(0);filter:none}35%{transform:translateX(11px);filter:brightness(1.8) sepia(.5)}48%{transform:translateX(-9px);filter:brightness(1.9)}65%{transform:translateX(6px);filter:brightness(1.4)}80%{transform:translateX(-3px)}}
.tq-fx{position:absolute;left:50%;top:40%;width:90px;height:90px;z-index:8;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);animation:tqFxPop .5s steps(5,end) forwards}
.tq-fx::before,.tq-fx::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:12px;border:6px solid #ffe5a0;transform:rotate(45deg);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #f39b6d,0 0 18px #fff}
.tq-fx::after{inset:28px;border:5px solid white;transform:rotate(0)}
.tq-fx.critical{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px #ffd14f);scale:1.25}
.tq-fx.enemy-hit::before{border-color:#fa8aa5;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #a75bf4,0 0 18px #ffb0c3}
.tq-damage{position:absolute;top:8%;left:50%;z-index:12;pointer-events:none;font-size:23px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;text-shadow:2px 2px #a53655,-2px -2px #a53655,0 4px #54265a;white-space:nowrap;animation:tqDamageRise .95s ease-out forwards}
.tq-damage.critical{font-size:28px;color:#ffe079;text-shadow:2px 2px #a64e00,-2px -2px #a64e00,0 4px #733700}
@keyframes tqFxPop{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.25) rotate(-20deg)}30%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.15) rotate(8deg)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.5) rotate(28deg)}}
@keyframes tqDamageRise{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,15px) scale(.7)}25%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-4px) scale(1.2)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-65px) scale(1)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.tq-fx,.tq-damage{animation:none;opacity:1}.actor-attack .actor-sprite-frame,.actor-hurt .actor-sprite-frame{animation:none!important}}
.battle-stage{min-height:260px!important;border:3px solid #4b4271;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#273a65 0%,#59669b 42%,#b9a2ae 63%,#4c586c 64%,#30344d 100%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 55px #11152b99,0 12px 30px #20203c30}
.battle-stage::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;opacity:.72;background:linear-gradient(120deg,transparent 22%,#fff4 23%,transparent 24%) 10% 18%/130px 130px,linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 7%,#161b38 7% 16%,transparent 16% 34%,#161b38 34% 41%,transparent 41% 67%,#161b38 67% 75%,transparent 75%) bottom/100% 54% no-repeat}
.battle-stage::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:24%;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#4d4564 0 44px,#35334d 44px 47px),repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0 20px,#191b2d66 20px 23px);border-top:7px solid #a2a4b2;box-shadow:0 -12px 30px #c8bde144}
.battle-stage.tq-forest{background:linear-gradient(#234b56 0%,#638d7c 55%,#526c54 56%,#253d38 100%)}
.battle-stage.tq-forest::before{background:radial-gradient(circle at 76% 21%,#dce8a7 0 22px,transparent 23px),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 32px,#203f3a 32px 48px,transparent 48px 95px) bottom/100% 75% no-repeat}
.battle-stage.tq-fire{background:linear-gradient(#391f37,#a54c48 57%,#3e283b 58%,#241e2c)}
.battle-stage.tq-fire::before{background:radial-gradient(circle at 30% 72%,#ffb45d88,transparent 30%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 60px,#42253d 60px 86px,transparent 86px 130px)}
.battle-stage.tq-ice{background:linear-gradient(#183f68,#7bc3d9 62%,#385879 63%,#243e5b)}
.battle-stage.tq-ice::before{background:repeating-linear-gradient(120deg,transparent 0 56px,#e5faff99 57px 63px,transparent 64px 100px)}
.battle-stage.tq-void{background:linear-gradient(#1a153d,#54458b 57%,#252144 58%,#17142e)}
.battle-stage.tq-void::before{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%,#a69aff77,transparent 35%),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 50px,#242046 50px 64px,transparent 64px 120px)}
.battle-stage .actor{position:relative;z-index:2;filter:drop-shadow(0 9px 3px #10132888)}
.battle-stage .battle-vs{position:relative;z-index:2;color:#fff;text-shadow:0 2px 6px #15172a}
.tq-floor-hud{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:12px;background:#242640;color:#fff;margin-bottom:10px;font-weight:800}
.tq-floor-hud small{color:#e4ddff;font-weight:500}
.tq-floor-meter{height:6px;border-radius:8px;background:#ffffff33;overflow:hidden;margin-top:6px}
.tq-floor-meter>i{display:block;height:100%;background:#a7e2d5;transition:width .4s}
.tq-floor-transition{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;display:grid;place-items:center;background:radial-gradient(circle at center,#3c3766,#141324 72%);color:white;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s}
.tq-floor-transition.active{opacity:1;pointer-events:all}
.tq-floor-transition .tq-door{width:min(78vw,350px);height:260px;border:14px solid #8e79ad;border-bottom:0;border-radius:160px 160px 0 0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#3c335d 0 26px,#4b406c 26px 52px);box-shadow:0 0 60px #b9a6ff44;animation:tqDoorApproach 1.45s ease-in both;display:grid;place-items:center}
.tq-floor-transition .tq-door strong{font-size:clamp(24px,6vw,42px);text-shadow:0 3px 8px #000}
.tq-floor-transition .tq-door span{font-size:15px;text-align:center}
@keyframes tqDoorApproach{0%{transform:scale(.5);filter:brightness(.7)}50%{transform:scale(1);filter:brightness(1.2)}100%{transform:scale(2.5);filter:brightness(2)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.tq-floor-transition .tq-door{animation:none}}
.hero-art{image-rendering:pixelated!important;object-fit:contain!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 2px #19172a55)!important}
.actor-sprite-frame img{image-rendering:pixelated!important;object-fit:contain!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 2px #10122888)!important}
.battle-stage .actor-sprite-frame{background:none!important;box-shadow:none!important}
.battle-panel{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#f8f5ff,#e6edff)!important}
.tq-ui-gallery{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:12px;margin:10px 0;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#29234a,#55447b);color:white}
.tq-ui-gallery img{height:64px;max-width:18%;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 2px #0005)}
.tq-ui-gallery b{width:100%;text-align:center;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.4px}
#game.active{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;max-height:calc(100dvh - 14px);overflow:hidden;padding:10px 12px!important;margin:0 auto!important;box-sizing:border-box}
body:has(#game.active) .container{padding-top:0!important;padding-bottom:0!important}
body:has(#game.active){overflow:hidden!important}
#game .game-hud{margin:0;flex-shrink:0;gap:4px}
#game .game-hud .stage-meta small{display:none}
#game .bar{margin:0;flex-shrink:0}
#game #progress{margin:0;font-size:11px}
#game #hp{margin:0;min-height:0}
#game .battle-panel{padding:5px 9px;margin:0;min-height:0;flex-shrink:1}
#game .battle-stage{min-height:130px!important;height:clamp(105px,19dvh,190px);overflow:hidden!important}
#game .actor-sprite-frame{height:clamp(66px,12dvh,120px);width:clamp(65px,13vw,120px)}
#game .actor-sprite-frame img{max-height:100%}
#game .tq-floor-hud{margin:0 0 3px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:12px}
#game #enemyDesc{display:none}
#game .enemy-health{margin:2px 0;font-size:10px}
#game .dice-result{padding:3px 7px;margin:2px 0;min-height:0}
#game .combat-objective{display:none}
#game #question{font-size:clamp(13px,2.3dvh,19px);line-height:1.32;margin:2px 0;padding:7px 10px;min-height:0}
#game #answers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:5px;min-height:0;flex:1 1 auto;align-content:stretch}
#game #answers .answer{padding:6px 9px;font-size:clamp(11px,1.9dvh,15px);line-height:1.25;min-height:0;height:100%;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#game #feedback{margin:0;min-height:0;font-size:11px;line-height:1.2}
#game #next,#game>button:last-child{margin:0;padding:5px 10px;font-size:11px;flex-shrink:0}
#game .tq-skill-float{position:absolute;right:12px;top:46px;z-index:100}
#game .tq-skill-toggle{width:39px;height:39px;padding:0;border-radius:12px;background:#41375e;color:#fff;font-size:29px;line-height:1;box-shadow:0 4px 12px #0004;display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer}
#game #tqSkillMenu{position:absolute;top:42px;right:0;width:min(310px,calc(100vw - 34px));max-height:min(66dvh,420px);overflow-y:auto;z-index:110;box-shadow:0 15px 45px #10102066;background:#f7f5ff;margin:0;padding:10px}
#game #tqSkillMenu[hidden]{display:none!important}
#game #tqSkillMenu button{display:flex;width:100%;justify-content:flex-start;margin:4px 0;padding:7px}
@media(max-width:620px){#game.active{padding:5px 7px!important;gap:2px}#game .battle-stage{min-height:105px!important;height:clamp(105px,17dvh,155px)}#game .game-stats{width:auto}#game .stage-meta strong{font-size:12px}#game .hud-chip{font-size:11px;padding:3px 5px}#game #answers .answer{font-size:clamp(10px,1.75dvh,13px);padding:4px 6px}#game #question{font-size:clamp(12px,2dvh,16px);padding:5px 7px}#game .tq-skill-float{top:38px;right:7px}}
:root{--bg:#0e1325;--surface:#202741;--surface-soft:#29324e;--surface-tint:#242d49;--text:#f5f5ff;--muted:#b8c2df;--border:#485472;--primary:#a99bff;--primary-dark:#8070e5;--primary-soft:#3a355f;--accent:#72d4d0;--success:#67e1b0;--success-soft:#1b4e4a;--danger:#ff829c;--danger-soft:#532d4a;--shadow:0 16px 48px #02061190;--radius:20px}
html{color-scheme:dark}
body{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 8%,#66559b4d,transparent 34%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 5% 80%,#276d7a40,transparent 43%),linear-gradient(160deg,#0d1327,#1b2440 55%,#101528)!important;color:var(--text);background-attachment:fixed!important}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.19;background-image:radial-gradient(circle,#d8d4ff 1px,transparent 1.6px);background-size:42px 42px;z-index:-1}
.card,.battle-panel,.screen.card{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#283250f2,#19213aef)!important;border:1px solid #63709988!important;box-shadow:0 16px 46px #060b1b88,inset 0 1px #ffffff1b!important}
h1,h2,h3,.stage-meta strong,.actor-name{color:#f7f2ff!important}
.muted,small,.stage-meta small{color:#b9c4e4}
button{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#384367,#28324f);color:#f7f5ff;border-color:#69759a}
button:hover:not(:disabled){background:linear-gradient(155deg,#4b5684,#343e63);border-color:#b5aaff}
button.primary,.primary-btn,.btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(115deg,#7767e6,#9c78df)!important;color:white!important}
input,select,textarea{background:#1a233c!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#5b688e!important}
input::placeholder{color:#b2b8d0}
.hud-chip,.game-hud,.tq-floor-hud{background:#202941!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#6b729a!important}
.bar{background:#10172b!important}
#game{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#242c4b,#171f37)!important}
#game .battle-panel{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#263350,#192139)!important}
#game .battle-stage{background:linear-gradient(#1d2852 0%,#546e9c 53%,#454568 54%,#24253d 100%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 48px #070b26aa,0 12px 22px #0005}
#game .battle-stage.tq-forest{background:linear-gradient(#193f53,#427a81 55%,#37565b 56%,#1c363c)}
#game .battle-stage.tq-fire{background:linear-gradient(#311735,#a64b59 56%,#592d41 57%,#2a1a2b)}
#game .battle-stage.tq-ice{background:linear-gradient(#17365b,#77bad4 57%,#486c94 58%,#20354f)}
#game .battle-stage.tq-void{background:linear-gradient(#1b103e,#51418b 56%,#392d6b 57%,#1b183a)}
#game .battle-stage .actor-sprite-frame{background:transparent!important}
#game .battle-stage img{image-rendering:pixelated}
#game .options button,#game .answer-btn{background:#303b5c;color:#fff;border:1px solid #6575a0}
#game .options button:hover,#game .answer-btn:hover{background:#45547b}
#game .tq-skill-toggle{background:linear-gradient(130deg,#7e6fe3,#5542a6)!important;color:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 6px 22px #0008}
.tq-floor-transition{background:radial-gradient(circle at center,#55477b,#0d1227 75%)!important}
.tq-floor-transition .tq-door{border-color:#c3adff!important;box-shadow:0 0 80px #9d87f988!important}
.tq-victory-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99998;display:grid;place-items:center;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;background:radial-gradient(circle,#e4d28a45,#141a35dd 72%);transition:opacity .25s}
.tq-victory-overlay.active{opacity:1}
.tq-victory-card{text-align:center;padding:30px;min-width:min(86vw,380px);border:2px solid #f6d989;border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#34305b,#171d39);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 65px #ffdb7988;animation:tqVictoryRise 1.5s ease both}
.tq-victory-card .tq-victory-star{font-size:64px;color:#ffdc82;text-shadow:0 0 28px #ffdd80;animation:tqVictoryPulse .55s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.tq-victory-card strong{display:block;font-size:clamp(24px,5vw,40px);color:#ffe39b}
.tq-victory-card span{color:#ddd9ff}
@keyframes tqVictoryRise{0%{transform:translateY(45px) scale(.72);opacity:0}25%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1.08);opacity:1}60%{transform:scale(1)}100%{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
@keyframes tqVictoryPulse{from{transform:scale(.9)}to{transform:scale(1.13)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.tq-victory-card,.tq-victory-star{animation:none!important}}
#game #question{
 color:#fff!important;
 background:#101a33!important;
 border:2px solid #9bafff!important;
 border-left:5px solid #86e4e0!important;
 border-radius:12px!important;
 text-shadow:none!important;
 font-weight:800!important;
 letter-spacing:.1px;
 box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #ffffff18,0 4px 16px #0005!important;
}
#game #stageTitle{color:#fff!important;text-shadow:0 1px 3px #0009!important;font-weight:900!important}
#game .stage-meta{padding:4px 9px;border-radius:9px;background:#111a35!important;border:1px solid #6978a7!important}
#game #progress,#game .hp-display,#game .enemy-health,#game #enemyHpText{color:#f2f5ff!important}
#game #tqFloorHud{background:#101a34!important;border:2px solid #98a8ed!important;color:#fff!important}
#game #tqFloorNow{font-weight:900!important;color:#fff!important;text-shadow:0 1px 3px #000a}
#game #tqZoneNow{color:#e5f0ff!important;font-weight:750!important}
#game .actor-name{color:#fff!important;text-shadow:0 2px 4px #060c22,0 0 8px #060c22!important}
#game .dice-result{color:#f7f8ff!important;background:#192643!important;border:1px solid #6278ae!important}
#game .dice-result small{color:#d5e2ff!important}
#game #answers .answer{color:#fff!important;background:#2d3b61!important;border:1.5px solid #8296c4!important;font-weight:700!important}
#game #answers .answer:hover:not(:disabled),#game #answers .answer:focus-visible{background:#475d92!important;outline:2px solid #b7e8ff!important;outline-offset:1px}
#game #feedback{color:#f5edff!important;font-weight:750!important;text-shadow:0 1px 3px #000a}
#stages .stage-card,#stages button{background:#1b2948!important;border:1.5px solid #647ba7!important;color:#fff!important}
#stages .stage-card b,#stages .stage-card strong,#stages button b{color:#fff!important}
#stages .stage-card small,#stages .stage-enemy-label,#stages .stage-state{color:#d8e6ff!important}
#stages .stage-card:hover:not(:disabled),#stages button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#34456d!important}
#tqSkillMenu{background:#1d2946!important;border:1px solid #91a0ce!important;color:#fff!important}
#tqSkillMenu strong,#tqSkillMenu p{color:#fff!important}
#tqSkillMenu button{color:#fff!important;background:#354569!important;border:1px solid #7f91bb!important}
@media(max-width:620px){
 #game #question{font-size:clamp(13px,2.05dvh,17px)!important;padding:6px 9px!important;line-height:1.28!important}
 #game .stage-meta{padding:2px 5px}
 #game #tqFloorHud{padding:3px 7px!important}
}
.tq-victory-overlay{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,#ffe3a5bb 0%,#ca8dcabb 46%,#2e234ce8 100%)!important;overflow:hidden}
.tq-victory-card{position:relative;isolation:isolate;border:5px solid #fff1bd!important;border-radius:28px!important;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#fff5ce,#f9c8df 52%,#c8a9ff)!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px #b37ad7,0 18px 0 #754a91,0 24px 70px #1a1232aa!important;color:#59345f!important;min-width:min(86vw,420px)!important;transform-origin:center}
.tq-victory-card::before{content:"✦  ✧  ✦  ✧  ✦";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-34px;color:#fff3a4;font-size:26px;text-shadow:0 0 12px #fff;animation:tqSparkles .9s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.tq-victory-card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:8px;border:2px dashed #ffffffb0;border-radius:19px;pointer-events:none}
.tq-victory-card .tq-victory-star{font-size:72px!important;color:#ffb932!important;text-shadow:0 3px #b55b60,0 0 18px #fff9bc!important}
.tq-victory-card strong{font-size:clamp(25px,5vw,43px)!important;color:#7b3d87!important;text-shadow:2px 3px #fff3c8!important}
.tq-victory-card span{color:#703e74!important;font-weight:900;font-size:18px}
@keyframes tqSparkles{from{opacity:.5;transform:translateY(0)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-9px)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.tq-victory-card::before{animation:none}}
.tq-victory-overlay{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#29134edc,#5b357bbd 50%,#25143fe8)!important;perspective:700px;isolation:isolate}
.tq-victory-glow{position:absolute;inset:-40%;background:repeating-conic-gradient(from 10deg,#ffeaa533 0 11deg,transparent 11deg 23deg);animation:tqSunburst 11s linear infinite;pointer-events:none}
.tq-victory-card{position:relative;min-width:min(88vw,440px)!important;padding:58px 28px 30px!important;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#fff8dd,#f7d8b7 50%,#eeb9c6)!important;border:5px solid #fff2c6!important;border-radius:25px!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #c48c52,0 0 0 11px #7b4d7c,0 15px 0 #653967,0 30px 75px #170d31d9!important;animation:tqRoyalPop 1.25s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both!important;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.tq-victory-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:10px;border:2px solid #b47a8e;border-radius:14px;pointer-events:none}
.tq-victory-card::after{content:"✦";position:absolute;right:19px;top:23px;font-size:34px;color:#fff8ce;text-shadow:0 0 12px #efaa47}
.tq-victory-crown{position:absolute;top:-69px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:85px;line-height:1;color:#ffe89a;text-shadow:0 5px 0 #a45b68,0 0 30px #fff4bd;animation:tqCrownBounce 1.3s ease both}
.tq-victory-ribbon{position:relative;margin:0 -54px 13px;padding:9px 12px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fa9ab1,#c94c86 60%,#a73d79);border:3px solid #ffe8b3;border-radius:7px;box-shadow:0 5px #873760;color:#fff6d6;letter-spacing:3px;font-weight:1000;font-size:clamp(18px,4vw,27px);text-shadow:0 2px #853c63;transform:rotate(-2deg)}
.tq-victory-ribbon::before,.tq-victory-ribbon::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:15px;border-top:25px solid #ae407b;border-bottom:25px solid #ae407b}
.tq-victory-ribbon::before{left:-19px;border-left:15px solid transparent}.tq-victory-ribbon::after{right:-19px;border-right:15px solid transparent}
.tq-victory-stars{font-size:clamp(25px,6vw,41px);letter-spacing:9px;color:#ffb92c;text-shadow:0 3px #b76542,0 0 15px #fff9bd;animation:tqStarsReveal .9s .22s both}
.tq-victory-title{color:#78426c!important;font-size:clamp(25px,5.4vw,37px)!important;text-shadow:0 2px #fff!important;margin:6px 0 4px}
.tq-victory-divider{height:3px;margin:12px auto;width:76%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#be8b7a,transparent)}
.tq-victory-reward{color:#794a6d!important;font-size:19px!important;font-weight:900}
.tq-victory-foot{font-size:12px;margin-top:10px;color:#986d78}
.tq-victory-bursts{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.tq-confetti{position:absolute;top:-12%;left:var(--x);width:var(--w);height:var(--h);background:var(--c);border-radius:2px;opacity:0;animation:tqConfettiFall var(--duration) var(--delay) ease-in forwards}
@keyframes tqRoyalPop{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(90px) rotateX(45deg) scale(.55)}55%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-10px) rotateX(-6deg) scale(1.07)}75%{transform:translateY(4px) rotateX(2deg) scale(.98)}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) rotateX(0) scale(1)}}
@keyframes tqCrownBounce{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-80px) rotate(-25deg)}65%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,10px) rotate(8deg)}100%{transform:translate(-50%,0) rotate(0)}}
@keyframes tqStarsReveal{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.2) rotate(-15deg)}70%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.18)}100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}}
@keyframes tqSunburst{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes tqConfettiFall{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,-15px,0) rotate(0)}10%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(var(--drift),110vh,0) rotate(var(--spin))}}
@media(max-width:480px){.tq-victory-card{padding:50px 15px 24px!important}.tq-victory-ribbon{margin-left:-28px;margin-right:-28px}.tq-victory-crown{font-size:68px;top:-57px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.tq-victory-glow,.tq-victory-card,.tq-victory-crown,.tq-victory-stars,.tq-confetti{animation:none!important}.tq-confetti{display:none}}
.tq-floor-transition{overflow:hidden!important;isolation:isolate;background:#32214f!important;transition:opacity .24s ease!important}
.tq-floor-transition.active{opacity:1!important;pointer-events:all!important}
.tq-travel-sky{position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 48%,#ffefd0 0%,#f7b9b6 35%,#b58bd2 72%,#5b4488 100%)}
.tq-travel-rays{position:absolute;inset:-70%;background:repeating-conic-gradient(from 10deg,#fff5d64a 0deg 13deg,transparent 13deg 28deg);animation:tqTravelSpin 12s linear infinite}
.tq-travel-curtain{position:absolute;top:-5%;height:110%;width:51%;z-index:3;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#863e82 0%,#ac5e99 12%,#8b4487 22%,#b76aa3 32%);border:5px solid #e6bd77;box-shadow:0 0 32px #2b133c77;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1)}
.tq-travel-curtain-left{left:0;transform:translateX(0);border-radius:0 0 24px 0}.tq-travel-curtain-right{right:0;transform:translateX(0);border-radius:0 0 0 24px}
.tq-floor-transition.active .tq-travel-curtain-left{transform:translateX(-108%)}.tq-floor-transition.active .tq-travel-curtain-right{transform:translateX(108%)}
.tq-travel-castle{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:-4%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:min(90vw,680px);height:43%;opacity:.7;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 15px #9e669b)}
.tq-travel-castle i{position:absolute;bottom:0;width:32%;height:70%;background:linear-gradient(#a46eac,#6e478c);border-radius:15px 15px 0 0}
.tq-travel-castle i::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-9%;top:-23%;width:118%;height:35%;background:#694a8c;clip-path:polygon(0 100%,50% 0,100% 100%)}
.tq-travel-castle i:nth-child(1){left:5%;height:57%}.tq-travel-castle i:nth-child(2){left:34%;height:100%}.tq-travel-castle i:nth-child(3){right:5%;height:57%}
.tq-travel-sparkles{position:absolute;top:15%;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:clamp(23px,6vw,45px);color:#fff8c6;text-shadow:0 0 16px #fff;animation:tqTravelTwinkle .65s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.tq-travel-plaque{position:relative;z-index:2;text-align:center;width:min(86vw,470px);padding:48px 22px 26px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff7d8,#f8d4ba 65%,#eec1d5);border:5px solid #fff2c8;border-radius:26px;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #bb8a57,0 0 0 11px #80508d,0 16px 0 #714a86,0 22px 50px #2d1b4f88;animation:tqTravelPop 1.2s cubic-bezier(.18,.9,.25,1) both}
.tq-travel-plaque::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:10px;border:2px dashed #c79c9b;border-radius:14px;pointer-events:none}
.tq-travel-crown{position:absolute;top:-54px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:72px;color:#ffeaa1;text-shadow:0 4px #a86c70,0 0 24px #fff}
.tq-travel-kicker{display:block;color:#a34c7d;font-size:clamp(17px,4vw,24px);font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:3px}
.tq-travel-plaque strong{display:block;color:#73436f!important;text-shadow:0 2px #fff!important;font-size:clamp(23px,5vw,36px);line-height:1.35;margin:9px 0}
.tq-travel-caption{color:#9b6681;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(12px,3vw,16px)}
.tq-travel-dots{color:#d5a043;font-size:24px;margin-top:9px;letter-spacing:9px;animation:tqTravelTwinkle .7s infinite alternate}
@keyframes tqTravelSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@keyframes tqTravelTwinkle{from{opacity:.4;transform:scale(.96)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.04)}}
@keyframes tqTravelPop{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(70px) scale(.65)}65%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-12px) scale(1.06)}100%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
@media(max-width:460px){.tq-travel-plaque{padding:38px 14px 19px}.tq-travel-crown{font-size:58px;top:-44px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.tq-travel-rays,.tq-travel-sparkles,.tq-travel-plaque,.tq-travel-dots{animation:none!important}.tq-travel-curtain{transition:none!important}}
#perkPanel{position:relative;z-index:30;background:#141c35!important;color:#fff!important;border:2px solid #c4b6ff!important;border-radius:18px!important;box-shadow:0 18px 55px #000c,0 0 0 4px #8f79dc55!important;padding:16px!important}
#perkPanel h2,#perkPanel h3,#perkPanel p,#perkPanel #perkChosen,#perkPanel #perkCountdown{color:#fff!important;text-shadow:none!important}
#perkPanel .perk-option{background:#293a61!important;color:#fff!important;border:2px solid #7c90c2!important;border-radius:12px!important;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #10192c!important}
#perkPanel .perk-option small{color:#e2eaff!important}
#perkPanel .perk-option.selected,#perkPanel .perk-option:focus-visible{background:#51429c!important;border-color:#ffe6a6!important;outline:2px solid #fff3c3!important}
#perkPanel button{color:#fff!important}
#game #tqSkillMenu{background:#17213d!important;color:#fff!important;border:2px solid #ac9df1!important;box-shadow:0 16px 45px #000c!important}
#game #tqSkillMenu button{background:#35456a!important;color:#fff!important;border:1px solid #8ca1ce!important}
#game #tqSkillMenu small,#game #tqSkillMenu p{color:#e4ecff!important}
#playerActor .actor-sprite-frame img.tq-frame-attack{object-fit:contain!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;image-rendering:pixelated!important}
body{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%,#273d4c,#101725 68%)!important}
#map .world-region{background:#121d2c!important;border:2px solid #607c83!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 24px #060d16,0 10px 24px #0007!important}
#map .world-region-head{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#152d37,#293d49)!important;border-bottom:2px solid #617b84!important}
#map .world-region-head h3{color:#fff4d7!important}
#map .map-node{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#344759,#1b2a3a)!important;border:2px solid #8196a2!important;color:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #0b1623!important}
#map .map-node.current{border-color:#f5c970!important;box-shadow:0 0 18px #e5ba6580!important}
#map .map-node.locked{opacity:.58}
#enemyPanel .battle-stage{background-image:linear-gradient(#08132125,#08132155),var(--tq-dungeon-bg)!important;background-size:cover!important;background-position:center!important;border:3px solid #637784!important;border-radius:15px!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 48px #030b16b8,0 6px 24px #0008!important}
#enemyPanel .battle-stage.tq-forest{background-image:linear-gradient(#081b1b15,#05131b55),var(--tq-forest-bg)!important}
#enemyPanel .battle-stage.tq-fire,#enemyPanel .battle-stage.tq-ice,#enemyPanel .battle-stage.tq-void{background-image:linear-gradient(#0d101e33,#0d101e77),var(--tq-dungeon-bg)!important}
#enemyPanel .actor-sprite-frame{background:transparent!important}
#enemyPanel .actor-name{background:#09111fcf;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:7px;border:1px solid #b6c5cb!important}
.tq-hero-picker{margin:12px 0 20px;padding:16px;background:#131e2ff2;border:2px solid #738a99;border-radius:18px;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 26px #0008}
.tq-hero-picker h3{margin:0 0 5px;color:#fce1a5!important}
.tq-hero-picker p{margin:0 0 10px;color:#d2deec}
.tq-hero-choices{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}
.tq-hero-choice{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;min-width:0;background:#273a4f!important;color:#fff!important;border:2px solid #647f92!important;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 3px!important}
.tq-hero-choice img{width:100%;max-width:110px;height:92px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated}
.tq-hero-choice span{font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.tq-hero-choice.active{border-color:#ffe18e!important;background:#5b4c76!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #f5d17855}
@media(max-width:540px){.tq-hero-choices{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.tq-hero-choice img{height:70px}}
#playerActor .actor-sprite-frame img,#enemyActor .actor-sprite-frame img{image-rendering:pixelated!important}
#enemyActor.tq-monster-strike .actor-sprite-frame{animation:tqMonsterStrike .5s steps(5,end)!important}
#enemyActor.tq-monster-hurt .actor-sprite-frame{animation:tqMonsterHurt .44s steps(4,end)!important}
#playerActor.tq-hero-hurt .actor-sprite-frame{animation:tqHeroHurt .55s steps(5,end)!important}
@keyframes tqMonsterStrike{0%{transform:translateX(0) scale(1)}20%{transform:translateX(12px) scale(.92)}45%{transform:translateX(-35px) scale(1.22) rotate(-7deg)}65%{transform:translateX(-42px) scale(1.16) rotate(7deg);filter:brightness(1.8)}100%{transform:translateX(0) scale(1)}}
@keyframes tqMonsterHurt{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0);filter:brightness(1)}25%{transform:translateX(10px) rotate(8deg);filter:brightness(2) sepia(1)}50%{transform:translateX(-7px) rotate(-7deg);filter:brightness(.6)}75%{transform:translateX(4px);filter:brightness(2)}}
@keyframes tqHeroHurt{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0);filter:brightness(1)}25%{transform:translateX(-11px) rotate(-7deg);filter:brightness(2)}50%{transform:translateX(7px) rotate(5deg);filter:brightness(.6)}75%{transform:translateX(-4px);filter:brightness(2)}}
.tq-hp-track{display:inline-block;vertical-align:middle;width:88px;height:12px;border-radius:99px;background:#3c2334;border:1px solid #bd7b8f;overflow:hidden}.tq-hp-track i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ee657e,#75e6a2);border-radius:99px;transition:width .28s}.hp-count{color:#fff!important;min-width:42px;text-align:right}
#enemyPanel .battle-stage{position:relative;overflow:hidden!important;min-height:clamp(140px,25dvh,255px)!important}
#enemyPanel .battle-stage .actor{position:relative;min-width:0;max-width:43%;flex:0 1 43%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:end}
#enemyPanel .battle-stage .actor-sprite-frame{width:clamp(72px,12vw,150px)!important;height:clamp(82px,17dvh,175px)!important;max-width:100%!important;display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:center;overflow:visible!important;transform-origin:50% 90%}
#enemyPanel .battle-stage .actor-sprite-frame img{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;max-height:100%!important;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center bottom!important;image-rendering:pixelated!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 2px #080d1bb0)}
#enemyPanel .battle-stage .actor-enemy .actor-sprite-frame{width:clamp(76px,14vw,165px)!important;height:clamp(85px,18dvh,185px)!important}
#enemyPanel .battle-stage .actor-name{max-width:100%;font-size:clamp(10px,1.7vw,14px);text-align:center;white-space:normal}
#enemyPanel .battle-stage .battle-vs{flex:0 0 auto}
#playerActor.tq-special-attack[data-hero-class="0"] .actor-sprite-frame{animation:tqSwordStep .56s steps(5,end) both!important}
#playerActor.tq-special-attack[data-hero-class="1"] .actor-sprite-frame{animation:tqBowStep .56s steps(5,end) both!important}
#playerActor.tq-special-attack[data-hero-class="2"] .actor-sprite-frame{animation:tqMagicStep .56s steps(5,end) both!important}
#playerActor.tq-special-attack[data-hero-class="3"] .actor-sprite-frame{animation:tqHealStep .56s steps(5,end) both!important}
#playerActor.tq-special-attack[data-hero-class="4"] .actor-sprite-frame{animation:tqRogueStep .56s steps(5,end) both!important}
#enemyActor.tq-monster-action .actor-sprite-frame{animation:tqMonsterFrame .56s steps(5,end) both!important}
#playerActor.tq-special-hurt .actor-sprite-frame{animation:tqPlayerDamage .54s steps(5,end) both!important}
#enemyActor.tq-special-hurt .actor-sprite-frame{animation:tqEnemyDamage .54s steps(5,end) both!important}
.tq-action-flash{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:50%;top:45%;width:75px;height:75px;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle,#ffffffd9 0 4%,#c4a3ff99 5% 24%,transparent 66%);mix-blend-mode:screen;animation:tqFlashMove .48s steps(5,end) forwards}
#playerActor[data-hero-class="1"] .tq-action-flash{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#a7eeca,transparent);height:8px;width:130px;transform:translateX(0)}
#playerActor[data-hero-class="2"] .tq-action-flash{background:radial-gradient(circle,#ffe5a6,#f26c4dbb 30%,transparent 68%)}
#playerActor[data-hero-class="3"] .tq-action-flash{background:radial-gradient(circle,#fffbd3,#9fe7ff88 35%,transparent 65%)}
#playerActor[data-hero-class="4"] .tq-action-flash{background:linear-gradient(120deg,transparent,#d8b4ff 45%,transparent);height:80px;width:15px}
#enemyActor .tq-action-flash{background:radial-gradient(circle,#ffddae,#ff8e8e77 40%,transparent 70%);animation:tqMonsterFlash .48s steps(5,end) forwards}
@keyframes tqSwordStep{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0) rotate(0)}20%{transform:translateX(12px) rotate(-9deg)}45%{transform:translateX(42px) rotate(12deg)}65%{transform:translateX(22px) rotate(0)}}
@keyframes tqBowStep{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}20%{transform:translateX(-8px) rotate(-6deg)}40%{transform:translateX(0) scale(1.08)}60%{transform:translateX(9px)}}
@keyframes tqMagicStep{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}25%{transform:translateY(-10px) rotate(-5deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-14px) scale(1.12)}70%{transform:translateY(-5px)}}
@keyframes tqHealStep{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}20%{transform:translateY(-7px)}45%{transform:translateY(-12px) scale(1.07)}70%{transform:translateY(-4px)}}
@keyframes tqRogueStep{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}20%{transform:translateX(-20px) scale(.85)}45%{transform:translateX(58px) scale(1.12)}65%{transform:translateX(24px)}}
@keyframes tqMonsterFrame{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0) scale(1)}20%{transform:translateX(12px) scale(.92)}40%{transform:translateX(-40px) scale(1.18) rotate(-8deg)}60%{transform:translateX(-30px) rotate(7deg)}}
@keyframes tqPlayerDamage{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0);filter:none}20%{transform:translateX(-14px) rotate(-8deg);filter:brightness(2)}40%{transform:translateX(7px) rotate(6deg);filter:brightness(.7)}60%{transform:translateX(-6px);filter:brightness(2)}}
@keyframes tqEnemyDamage{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0);filter:none}20%{transform:translateX(14px) rotate(8deg);filter:brightness(2)}40%{transform:translateX(-7px) rotate(-6deg);filter:brightness(.7)}60%{transform:translateX(6px);filter:brightness(2)}}
@keyframes tqFlashMove{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.1)}40%{opacity:1;transform:translate(45%,-50%) scale(1)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(95%,-50%) scale(.3)}}
@keyframes tqMonsterFlash{0%{opacity:0;transform:translate(0,-50%) scale(.1)}45%{opacity:1;transform:translate(-85%,-50%) scale(1)}100%{opacity:0;transform:translate(-140%,-50%) scale(.3)}}
@media(max-width:600px){
 #enemyPanel .battle-stage{min-height:clamp(115px,22dvh,175px)!important}
 #enemyPanel .battle-stage .actor-sprite-frame{width:clamp(60px,21vw,95px)!important;height:clamp(75px,15dvh,120px)!important}
 #enemyPanel .battle-stage .actor-enemy .actor-sprite-frame{width:clamp(66px,24vw,105px)!important;height:clamp(78px,16dvh,125px)!important}
 .tq-action-flash{width:48px;height:48px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#enemyPanel .tq-special-attack .actor-sprite-frame,#enemyPanel .tq-special-hurt .actor-sprite-frame,#enemyPanel .tq-monster-action .actor-sprite-frame{animation:none!important}}
html{min-height:100%;background:#081b1a}
body{min-height:100dvh;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#08121c55,#07121fc9),url('data:image/jpeg;base64,') center center / cover fixed no-repeat!important}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#07121ba8,#07121b55 40%,#07121b99),radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,transparent 15%,#07131b77 90%);pointer-events:none;z-index:-1}
#home,#map,#game,#login,#signup,#results,#result,#admin,#knowledge{background:transparent!important}
.card,.screen.card,.battle-panel,.tq-hero-picker{background:#111d2fe8!important;backdrop-filter:blur(9px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(9px);border:1px solid #a7d4c47d!important;box-shadow:0 12px 36px #030b13a8!important}
#game .battle-stage{background-image:linear-gradient(#08132125,#08132155),url('data:image/jpeg;base64,')!important;background-position:center!important;background-size:cover!important}
#game .battle-stage.tq-forest{background-image:linear-gradient(#08132125,#08132155),url('data:image/jpeg;base64,')!important}
#game .battle-stage.tq-fire,#game .battle-stage.tq-ice,#game .battle-stage.tq-void{background-image:linear-gradient(#08132125,#08132155),url('data:image/jpeg;base64,')!important}
@media(max-width:720px){body{background-attachment:scroll!important;background-position:center top!important}body::before{background:#06121a70}}
.tq-hp-track{min-width:60px}.hp-count{min-width:75px!important;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}\n</style>
</head>
<body>

<button id="deviceModeToggle" type="button" aria-label="เปลี่ยนโหมดการแสดงผล" aria-pressed="false" onclick="toggleDeviceMode()"><span class="mode-icon" id="deviceModeIcon" aria-hidden="true"></span><span id="deviceModeLabel">โหมดมือถือ</span></button>
<div class="container">


<section id="authScreen" class="screen auth-screen">
 <div class="auth-layout">
  <aside class="auth-side">
   <div class="auth-logo"><span class="auth-logo-mark">TQ</span></div>
   <h1>TECH QUEST</h1>
   <p>ยินดีต้อนรับสู่โลกแห่งการผจญภัย เรียนรู้เทคโนโลยีและพิชิตหอคอยแห่งความรู้</p>
   <div class="auth-caption">LOGIN · SIGN UP</div>
  </aside>
  <div class="auth-panel">
   <form id="loginForm" class="auth-form active" onsubmit="event.preventDefault();loginAccount()">
    <h2>เข้าสู่ระบบ</h2>
    <p class="auth-sub">กลับมาผจญภัยต่อใน TECH QUEST</p>
    <label class="auth-field">อีเมลหรือชื่อบัญชี
     <input id="loginIdentity" type="text" autocomplete="username" placeholder="กรอกอีเมลหรือชื่อบัญชี" required>
    </label>
    <label class="auth-field">รหัสผ่าน
     <input id="loginPassword" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" placeholder="กรอกรหัสผ่าน" required>
    </label>
    <div id="loginMessage" class="auth-message" aria-live="polite"></div>
    <button class="auth-submit" type="submit">เข้าสู่ระบบ</button>
    <p class="auth-switch">ยังไม่มีบัญชี? <button class="auth-link" type="button" onclick="switchAuth('signup')" data-auth-target="signup">สมัครบัญชี</button></p>
   </form>
   <form id="signupForm" class="auth-form" onsubmit="event.preventDefault();registerAccount()">
    <h2>สร้างบัญชีใหม่</h2>
    <p class="auth-sub">สมัครสมาชิกเพื่อเริ่มต้นการผจญภัย</p>
    <label class="auth-field">ชื่อผู้เล่น
     <input id="signupName" type="text" maxlength="18" autocomplete="nickname" placeholder="ชื่อที่ใช้ในเกม" required>
    </label>
    <label class="auth-field">อีเมล
     <input id="signupEmail" type="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="name@example.com" required>
    </label>
    <label class="auth-field">รหัสผ่าน
     <input id="signupPassword" type="password" minlength="6" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="อย่างน้อย 6 ตัวอักษร" required>
    </label>
    <label class="auth-field">ยืนยันรหัสผ่าน
     <input id="signupConfirm" type="password" minlength="6" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="กรอกรหัสผ่านอีกครั้ง" required>
    </label>
    <div id="signupMessage" class="auth-message" aria-live="polite"></div>
    <button class="auth-submit" type="submit">สมัครบัญชี</button>
    <p class="auth-switch">มีบัญชีอยู่แล้ว? <button class="auth-link" type="button" onclick="switchAuth('login')" data-auth-target="login">เข้าสู่ระบบ</button></p>
   </form>
   <p class="auth-note">บัญชีรุ่นทดลองนี้จัดเก็บไว้ในเบราว์เซอร์เครื่องนี้ ยังไม่ใช่ระบบสมาชิกออนไลน์</p>
  </div>
 </div>
</section>

<header class="app-topbar">
 <div class="brand-lockup">
  <div class="brand-mark"><span class="line-icon" data-icon="code"></span></div>
  <div class="brand-copy"><strong>TECH QUEST</strong><small>MINIMAL ADVENTURE</small></div>
 </div>
 <div class="top-actions">
  <button id="adminTopBtn" style="display:none" onclick="adminScreen()"><span class="line-icon" data-icon="shield"></span>แอดมิน</button>
  <button onclick="leaderboard()"><span class="line-icon" data-icon="trophy"></span>อันดับ</button>
  <button class="auth-logout" onclick="logoutAccount()">ออกจากระบบ</button>
 </div>
</header>

<section id="home" class="screen active card">
<div class="tq-ui-gallery"><b>PIXEL HEROES • MONSTERS • BOSSES</b><img alt="ตัวละคร Pixel Art" src="data:image/png;base64,"><img alt="ตัวละคร Pixel Art" src="data:image/png;base64,"><img alt="ตัวละคร Pixel Art" src="data:image/png;base64,"><img alt="ตัวละคร Pixel Art" src="data:image/png;base64,"><img alt="ตัวละคร Pixel Art" src="data:image/png;base64,"><img alt="ตัวละคร Pixel Art" src="data:image/png;base64,"></div><div class="hero-wrap"><img class="hero-art" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Tech Hero ตัวละครหลัก"><div><h1>TECH QUEST</h1><h2 style="text-align:center">PIXEL ADVENTURE</h2><p class="muted" style="text-align:center">รับบท Tech Hero นักสำรวจโลกไซเบอร์</p></div></div>
<p class="muted" style="text-align:center">ออกสำรวจโลกเทคโนโลยี สะสม XP ดาว และพิชิตแรงก์สูงสุด</p>

<div class="grid">
<button class="stat" onclick="detail('level')"><b id="hlevel">Lv.1</b>เลเวล • กดดู</button>
<div class="stat"><b id="hxp">0</b>XP</div>
<button class="stat" onclick="detail('rank')"><b id="hrank">Bronze</b>แรงก์ • กดดู</button>
</div>

<div class="home-actions">
<button class="main" onclick="mapScreen()"><span class="line-icon" data-icon="tower"></span>เริ่มไต่หอคอย</button>
<button onclick="leaderboard()"><span class="line-icon" data-icon="trophy"></span>อันดับผู้เล่น</button>
<button onclick="bestiaryScreen()"><span class="line-icon" data-icon="book"></span>คลังมอนสเตอร์</button>
<button class="gold" onclick="knowledgeScreen()"><span class="line-icon" data-icon="brain"></span>คลังความรู้</button>
<button onclick="manualSave()"><span class="line-icon" data-icon="save"></span>บันทึกตอนนี้</button>
<button onclick="exportSave()"><span class="line-icon" data-icon="download"></span>สำรองข้อมูล</button>
<label class="backup-label"><span class="line-icon" data-icon="upload"></span>กู้คืนข้อมูล <input type="file" accept="application/json,.json" onchange="importSave(event)" style="max-width:190px"></label>
<button onclick="resetGame()">รีเซ็ตข้อมูล</button>
<p id="saveStatus" class="muted" style="grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center">ระบบจะบันทึกความคืบหน้าอัตโนมัติ</p>
</div>
</section>

<section id="map" class="screen card">
<h2 class="section-title"><span class="line-icon" data-icon="tower"></span>หอคอย TECH QUEST</h2>
<p class="muted">ไต่ขึ้นทั้งหมด 50 ชั้น พบมอนสเตอร์ทุกชั้น และต่อสู้กับบอสทุก ๆ 5 ชั้น (ชั้น 5, 10, 15 ... 50)</p>
<div class="tower-banner"><span class="line-icon" data-icon="tower"></span><span>ทั้งหมด 50 ชั้น</span><span class="line-icon" data-icon="shield"></span><span>มอนสเตอร์ทุกชั้น</span><span class="line-icon" data-icon="crown"></span><span>บอสทุก 5 ชั้น</span></div>

<div class="map-form">
 <label class="map-field">ชื่อนักสำรวจ<input id="playerName" maxlength="18" placeholder="ชื่อผู้เล่น"></label>
 <label class="map-field">เลือกระดับความยาก
  <select id="difficulty" onchange="updateDifficultyDisplay();saveGame()">
   <option value="easy">ง่าย • เริ่มต้น 45 วินาที</option>
   <option value="normal">ปกติ • เริ่มต้น 40 วินาที</option>
   <option value="hard">ยาก • เริ่มต้น 35 วินาที</option>
   <option value="expert">โหด • เริ่มต้น 30 วินาที</option>
  </select>
 </label>
 <p id="difficultyProgress" class="muted">ระดับความยากจะเพิ่มขึ้น 1 ระดับทุกครั้งที่ผ่านชั้นใหม่</p>
</div>

<div class="grid">
<button class="stat" onclick="detail('level')"><b id="mlevel">Lv.1</b>เลเวล</button>
<div class="stat"><b id="mxp">0</b>XP</div>
<button class="stat" onclick="detail('rank')"><b id="mrank">Bronze</b>แรงก์</button>
</div>

<section class="tq-hero-picker"><h3>เลือกตัวละครหลัก</h3><p>เลือกฮีโร่ก่อนเข้าดันเจี้ยน (เปลี่ยนได้ทุกเมื่อ)</p><div id="tqHeroChoices" class="tq-hero-choices"></div></section><div class="grid" id="stages"></div>

<div class="home-actions">
<button class="main" onclick="friendGame()"><span class="line-icon" data-icon="users"></span>เล่นกับเพื่อน</button>
<button onclick="bestiaryScreen()"><span class="line-icon" data-icon="book"></span>คลังมอนสเตอร์และบอส</button>
<button class="gold" onclick="knowledgeScreen()"><span class="line-icon" data-icon="brain"></span>คลังความรู้</button>
<button onclick="homeScreen()">หน้าหลัก</button>
</div>
</section>

<section id="game" class="screen card">
<div class="game-hud">
 <div class="stage-meta"><small>กำลังเล่น</small><strong id="stageTitle"></strong></div>
 <div class="game-stats">
  <div class="hud-chip">คะแนน <b id="score">0</b></div>
  <div class="hud-chip"><span class="line-icon" data-icon="clock"></span>เวลา <b id="time">30</b></div>
 </div>
</div>
<div class="bar"><div id="timebar"></div></div>
<p id="progress">ข้อ 1/9</p>
<div id="hp" class="hp-display" aria-label="พลังชีวิต"></div>
<div id="enemyPanel" class="battle-panel">
