 <div id="tqFloorHud" class="tq-floor-hud" aria-live="polite"><div><span id="tqFloorNow">ชั้น 1 / 50</span><div class="tq-floor-meter"><i id="tqFloorProgress" style="width:2%"></i></div></div><small id="tqZoneNow">เขตเริ่มต้น</small></div><div class="battle-stage tq-forest">

  </div>
 </div>

 <div id="diceResult" class="dice-result" aria-live="polite"><span class="dice-cube">?</span><span><b>ลูกเต๋าพร้อมทอย</b><small>ตอบถูกโจมตี • ตอบผิดศัตรูสวนกลับ</small></span></div>

 <div class="grid">

   <option value="AI">ปัญญาประดิษฐ์ (AI)</option>
   <option value="การเขียนโปรแกรม">การเขียนโปรแกรม</option>

<script>

const ICON_PATHS={
 code:'<path d="m8 8-4 4 4 4M16 8l4 4-4 4M14 5l-4 14"/>',
 trophy:'<path d="M8 21h8M12 17v4M7 4h10v5a5 5 0 0 1-10 0V4Z"/><path d="M7 6H4v2a4 4 0 0 0 4 4M17 6h3v2a4 4 0 0 1-4 4"/>',
 tower:'<path d="M4 21h16M6 21V8h12v13M8 8V4h8v4M10 12h4M10 16h4"/>',
 book:'<path d="M4 5.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 3H20v17H6.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 4 22V5.5Z"/><path d="M4 18a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 2.5-2.5H20"/>',
 save:'<path d="M5 3h12l4 4v14H3V3h2Z"/><path d="M7 3v6h10V3M7 21v-8h10v8"/>',
 download:'<path d="M12 3v12m0 0 4-4m-4 4-4-4M4 19v2h16v-2"/>',
 upload:'<path d="M12 16V4m0 0 4 4m-4-4L8 8M4 17v4h16v-4"/>',
 clock:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 7v5l3 2"/>',
 search:'<circle cx="10.8" cy="10.8" r="6.8"/><path d="m16 16 4.5 4.5"/>',
 scan:'<path d="M4 8V4h4M16 4h4v4M20 16v4h-4M8 20H4v-4"/><path d="M7 12h10"/>',
 zap:'<path d="m13 2-9 12h7l-1 8 10-13h-7l0-7Z"/>',
 heart:'<path d="M20.5 8.8c0 5-8.5 11-8.5 11s-8.5-6-8.5-11A4.5 4.5 0 0 1 12 6.2a4.5 4.5 0 0 1 8.5 2.6Z"/>',
 shield:'<path d="M12 3 20 6v5c0 5-3.4 8.2-8 10-4.6-1.8-8-5-8-10V6l8-3Z"/><path d="m9 12 2 2 4-4"/>',
 monitor:'<rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M8 21h8M12 17v4"/>',
 users:'<path d="M16 20v-1.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0-3.5-3.5h-5A3.5 3.5 0 0 0 4 18.5V20"/><circle cx="10" cy="8" r="3.5"/><path d="M17 4.8a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 6.8M20 20v-1.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 0-2.5-3.35"/>',
 check:'<path d="m5 12 4 4L19 6"/>',
 lock:'<rect x="4" y="10" width="16" height="11" rx="2"/><path d="M8 10V7a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v3M12 14v3"/>',
 arrow:'<path d="M5 12h14m-6-6 6 6-6 6"/>',
 spark:'<path d="m12 3 1.8 5.2L19 10l-5.2 1.8L12 17l-1.8-5.2L5 10l5.2-1.8L12 3Z"/><path d="m19 15 .8 2.2L22 18l-2.2.8L19 21l-.8-2.2L16 18l2.2-.8L19 15Z"/>',
 brain:'<path d="M9 4a3 3 0 0 0-5 2.2A3.5 3.5 0 0 0 4 13a3.5 3.5 0 0 0 5 5"/><path d="M15 4a3 3 0 0 1 5 2.2A3.5 3.5 0 0 1 20 13a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-5 5"/><path d="M9 4v16M15 4v16M9 9H6M15 9h3M9 14H6M15 14h3"/>',
 crown:'<path d="m3 8 5 4 4-7 4 7 5-4-2 11H5L3 8Z"/><path d="M5 21h14"/>',
 user:'<circle cx="12" cy="8" r="4"/><path d="M4 21a8 8 0 0 1 16 0"/>',
 globe:'<circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M3 12h18M12 3a14 14 0 0 1 0 18M12 3a14 14 0 0 0 0 18"/>',
 database:'<ellipse cx="12" cy="5" rx="8" ry="3"/><path d="M4 5v7c0 1.7 3.6 3 8 3s8-1.3 8-3V5M4 12v7c0 1.7 3.6 3 8 3s8-1.3 8-3v-7"/>'
};
function iconSvg(name,size=18){
 const path=ICON_PATHS[name]||ICON_PATHS.spark;
 return `<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="${size}" height="${size}" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">${path}</svg>`;
}
function categoryIcon(category){
 return ({'คอมพิวเตอร์':'monitor','อินเทอร์เน็ต':'globe','ความปลอดภัยไซเบอร์':'shield','AI':'brain','การเขียนโปรแกรม':'code','เทคโนโลยีทั่วไป':'database'})[category]||'book';
}
function renderHP(){
 const total=Math.max(3,Number(maxLives)||3,Number(lives)||0);
 const filled=Math.max(0,Math.min(total,Number(lives)||0));
 return `<span>HP</span><span class="tq-hp-track"><i style="width:${Math.max(0,Math.min(100,100*tqHealth/tqMaxHealth))}%"></i></span><strong class="hp-count">${Math.round(tqHealth)}/${tqMaxHealth}</strong>`;
}

function tqCombatImpact(targetId,damage,critical=false){
 const actor=document.getElementById(targetId);
 if(!actor)return;
 const stage=actor.closest('.battle-stage');
 if(!stage)return;
 const effect=document.createElement('span');
 effect.className='tq-fx'+(critical?' critical':'')+(targetId==='playerActor'?' enemy-hit':'');
 effect.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
 const label=document.createElement('span');
 label.className='tq-damage'+(critical?' critical':'');
 label.textContent=(critical?'CRITICAL! ':'')+'-'+Math.max(0,Number(damage)||0);
 label.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
 actor.append(effect,label);
 setTimeout(()=>{effect.remove();label.remove()},1100);
}
const tqAttackFrames=["data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,"];

let tqAttackTimer=null;
const tqHeroSprites=[["data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,"], ["data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,"]];
const tqDungeonBackgrounds=["data:image/jpeg;base64,", "data:image/jpeg;base64,"];

const tqHeroNames=['อัศวิน','นักธนู','จอมเวท','นักบวช','นักลอบเร้น'];
let tqSelectedHero=0;
try{tqSelectedHero=Number(localStorage.getItem('tq_selected_hero')||0);}catch(e){tqSelectedHero=0;}
if(!Number.isInteger(tqSelectedHero)||tqSelectedHero<0||tqSelectedHero>4)tqSelectedHero=0;
function tqApplyHero(){
 const src=tqHeroSprites[0][tqSelectedHero];
 const hero=document.querySelector('.hero-art');if(hero)hero.src=src;
 const art=document.getElementById('playerBattleArt');if(art)art.src=src;
 const label=document.getElementById('playerActorName');if(label)label.textContent=tqHeroNames[tqSelectedHero];
}
function tqRenderHeroPicker(){
 const el=document.getElementById('tqHeroChoices');if(!el)return;
 el.replaceChildren();
 tqHeroNames.forEach((name,i)=>{
  const b=document.createElement('button');b.type='button';b.className='tq-hero-choice'+(i===tqSelectedHero?' active':'');
  const pic=document.createElement('img');pic.src=tqHeroSprites[0][i];pic.alt=name;
  const t=document.createElement('span');t.textContent=name;
  b.append(pic,t);b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
   tqSelectedHero=i;try{localStorage.setItem('tq_selected_hero',String(i));}catch(e){}
   tqApplyHero();tqRenderHeroPicker();
  });el.appendChild(b);
 });
 tqApplyHero();
}
function tqPlayHeroHurt(){
 const art=document.getElementById('playerBattleArt');if(!art)return;
 clearInterval(tqAttackTimer);clearTimeout(tqOtherAttackTimeout);
 const hero=tqSelectedHero;const frame=tqHeroSprites[1][hero];art.src=frame;
 const el=document.getElementById('playerActor');if(el){el.classList.remove('tq-hero-hurt');void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add('tq-hero-hurt');}
 setTimeout(()=>{if(tqSelectedHero===hero)art.src=tqHeroSprites[0][hero];if(el)el.classList.remove('tq-hero-hurt');},540);
}
function tqAnimateMonster(state){
 const el=document.getElementById('enemyActor');if(!el)return;
 el.classList.remove('tq-monster-strike','tq-monster-hurt');void el.offsetWidth;
 const cls=state==='attack'?'tq-monster-strike':'tq-monster-hurt';
 el.classList.add(cls);setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove(cls),state==='attack'?500:440);
}


let tqOtherAttackTimeout=null;
function tqPlayOtherHeroAttack(){
 const art=document.getElementById('playerBattleArt');if(!art)return;
 clearTimeout(tqOtherAttackTimeout);
 const hero=tqSelectedHero;
 const ready=tqHeroSprites[0][hero], action=tqHeroSprites[1][hero];
 art.src=ready;
 tqOtherAttackTimeout=setTimeout(()=>{if(tqSelectedHero===hero)art.src=action;},115);
 tqOtherAttackTimeout=setTimeout(()=>{if(tqSelectedHero===hero)art.src=ready;},410);
}

function tqPlayFrameAttack(){
 const art=document.getElementById('playerBattleArt');if(!art)return;
 clearInterval(tqAttackTimer);
 const original=tqHeroSprites[0][tqSelectedHero];
 let i=0;
 art.classList.add('tq-frame-attack');
 art.src=tqAttackFrames[i];
 tqAttackTimer=setInterval(()=>{
   i++;
   if(i>=tqAttackFrames.length){
     clearInterval(tqAttackTimer);tqAttackTimer=null;
     art.src=original;art.classList.remove('tq-frame-attack');return;
   }
   art.src=tqAttackFrames[i];
 },78);
}


let tqCombatCleanup=null;
function tqAttackVisual(actorId,state){
 const actor=document.getElementById(actorId);if(!actor)return;
 actor.classList.remove('tq-special-attack','tq-special-hurt','tq-monster-action');
 actor.querySelectorAll('.tq-action-flash').forEach(n=>n.remove());
 void actor.offsetWidth;
 if(state==='attack'){
  actor.classList.add(actorId==='enemyActor'?'tq-monster-action':'tq-special-attack');
  if(actorId==='playerActor')actor.dataset.heroClass=String(tqSelectedHero);
  else actor.dataset.monsterClass=String(stages[currentStage].isBoss?5:Math.floor(currentStage/5)%4+1);
  const flash=document.createElement('span');
  flash.className='tq-action-flash';flash.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  actor.appendChild(flash);
  setTimeout(()=>flash.remove(),540);
 }else if(state==='hurt')actor.classList.add('tq-special-hurt');
 setTimeout(()=>actor.classList.remove('tq-special-attack','tq-special-hurt','tq-monster-action'),580);
}

function playActorAnimation(actorId,state,duration=700){
 if(state==="attack"||state==="hurt")tqAttackVisual(actorId,state);
 if(actorId==="playerActor"&&state==="attack"){if(tqSelectedHero===0)tqPlayFrameAttack();else tqPlayOtherHeroAttack();}
 if(actorId==="playerActor"&&state==="hurt")tqPlayHeroHurt();
 if(actorId==="enemyActor"&&(state==="attack"||state==="hurt"))tqAnimateMonster(state);
 const actor=document.getElementById(actorId);if(!actor)return;
 const states=['actor-idle','actor-walk','actor-attack','actor-hurt'];
 actor.classList.remove(...states);
 void actor.offsetWidth;
 actor.classList.add('actor-'+state);
 if(state!=='idle'){
  window.setTimeout(()=>{if(actor.classList.contains('actor-'+state)){actor.classList.remove('actor-'+state);actor.classList.add('actor-idle');}},duration);
 }
}

const TOTAL_FLOORS=50;
const stages=Array.from({length:TOTAL_FLOORS},(_,i)=>{
 const floor=i+1, theme=baseStages[Math.floor(i/5)%baseStages.length];
 const boss=floor%5===0;
 const monster=monsterPool[i%monsterPool.length];
 const bossInfo=boss?bossPool[(floor/5)-1]:null;
 const floorQuestions=theme.questions.map((q,qi)=>{
  const labels=["ภารกิจทดสอบ","โจทย์วิเคราะห์","บททดสอบความเข้าใจ","ภารกิจภาคสนาม","ด่านท้าทาย","คำถามนักสำรวจ","แบบทดสอบพิเศษ","โจทย์ประจำด่าน","ภารกิจความรู้"];
  return [`ชั้น ${floor} • ${labels[qi%labels.length]}: ${q[0]}`,q[1],q[2]];
 });
 return {name:theme.name,icon:theme.icon,monster:boss?bossInfo:monster,isBoss:boss,questions:floorQuestions};
});

const SAVE_VERSION = 2;
const SAVE_KEYS = ["TECH_QUEST_SAVE_A", "TECH_QUEST_SAVE_B", "TECH_QUEST_BACKUP"];
let data = { name:"นักสำรวจ", xp:0, stars:0, unlocked:1, cleared:[], knowledge:[] };
let leaderboardData = [];
let saveNotice = "";

let currentStage=0,questions=[],index=0,score=0,correct=0,lives=3;
let enemyDamageTotal=0,enemyMaxHP=100;
let tqHealth=200,tqCarryHealth=null;
let tqMaxHealth=200;
let skillUses={scan:0,boost:0,heal:0};
let scanActiveIndex=-1;
let timer=null,time=30,answered=false,lastChoice=null;
let correctAdvanceTimer=null,perkTimer=null,perkSeconds=35,selectedPerk=null,floorPerk=null,activeFloorPerk=null,maxLives=3;
let friendMode=false,friendPlayers=[],friendScores=[],friendTurn=0;
let previousScreen="home";

function checksum(value){
 const text=JSON.stringify(value); let hash=2166136261;
 for(let i=0;i<text.length;i++){hash^=text.charCodeAt(i);hash=Math.imul(hash,16777619);}
 return (hash>>>0).toString(16);
}
function validProfile(p){
 return !!p && typeof p.name==="string" && p.name.length<=18 &&
  Number.isSafeInteger(p.xp) && p.xp>=0 && Number.isSafeInteger(p.stars) && p.stars>=0 &&
  Number.isInteger(p.unlocked) && p.unlocked>=1 && p.unlocked<=stages.length &&
  Array.isArray(p.cleared) && p.cleared.every(n=>Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=0&&n<stages.length);
}
function makeSave(){
 const active=document.getElementById("game").classList.contains("active") && !friendMode;
 return {profile:{...data,cleared:[...data.cleared]}, leaderboard:leaderboardData,
  session:{active,carryHealth:tqCarryHealth,stage:currentStage,questions:questions.map(q=>[q[0],[...q[1]],q[2]]),index,score,correct,lives,tqHealth,tqMaxHealth,time,answered:!!answered,choice:lastChoice,skillUses:{...skillUses},scanActiveIndex,enemyDamageTotal,enemyMaxHP,reviewQueue:tqReviewQueue,reviewMode:tqReviewMode,reviewAttempts:tqReviewAttempts,unresolved:[...tqUnresolved],baseQuestionCount:tqBaseQuestionCount,
   difficulty:document.getElementById("difficulty").value},
  meta:{savedAt:Date.now(),playerId:"local-player"}};
}
function validEnvelope(e){
 if(!e||e.version!==SAVE_VERSION||!e.data||e.checksum!==checksum(e.data)) return false;
 const d=e.data, s=d.session;
 if(!validProfile(d.profile)||!Array.isArray(d.leaderboard)) return false;
 if(!s||typeof s.active!=="boolean") return false;
 if(s.skillUses!==undefined && (!s.skillUses || typeof s.skillUses!=="object" || ["scan","boost","heal"].some(k=>!(typeof s.skillUses[k]==="boolean" || (Number.isInteger(s.skillUses[k])&&s.skillUses[k]>=0&&s.skillUses[k]<=2))))) return false;
 if(s.active && (!Number.isInteger(s.stage)||s.stage<0||s.stage>=stages.length||!Array.isArray(s.questions)||s.questions.length<1||s.questions.length>2000||
  !s.questions.every(q=>Array.isArray(q)&&q.length===3&&typeof q[0]==="string"&&Array.isArray(q[1])&&q[1].length===4&&q[1].every(a=>typeof a==="string")&&Number.isInteger(q[2])&&q[2]>=0&&q[2]<4)||
  !Number.isInteger(s.index)||s.index<0||s.index>=s.questions.length||!Number.isFinite(s.score)||s.score<0||!Number.isInteger(s.correct)||s.correct<0||s.correct>s.questions.length||
  !Number.isInteger(s.lives)||s.lives<0||s.lives>4||!Number.isFinite(s.time)||s.time<0||s.time>60||
  typeof s.answered!=="boolean"||!(s.choice===null||(Number.isInteger(s.choice)&&s.choice>=-1&&s.choice<4))||
  !["easy","normal","hard","expert"].includes(s.difficulty))) return false;
 return true;
}
function readSave(key){
 try{const raw=localStorage.getItem(key);if(!raw)return null;const e=JSON.parse(raw);return validEnvelope(e)?e:null;}catch{return null;}
}
function loadBestSave(){
 try{
  return SAVE_KEYS.map(key=>({key,envelope:readSave(key)}))
   .filter(x=>x.envelope)
   .sort((a,b)=>b.envelope.savedAt-a.envelope.savedAt)[0]||null;
 }catch{return null;}
}
function saveGame(){
 try{
  const payload=makeSave();
  if(!validProfile(payload.profile)) throw new Error("ข้อมูลผู้เล่นไม่ถูกต้อง");
  const previous=loadBestSave();
  const envelope={version:SAVE_VERSION,savedAt:Date.now(),data:payload,checksum:checksum(payload)};
  // เก็บชุดล่าสุดเดิมไว้เป็นข้อมูลสำรอง ก่อนเขียนชุดใหม่
  if(previous && previous.envelope){
   try{localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEYS[2],JSON.stringify(previous.envelope));}catch(backupError){console.warn("สร้างข้อมูลสำรองไม่สำเร็จ",backupError);}
  }
  // สลับช่อง A/B เพื่อไม่เขียนทับชุดล่าสุดทุกครั้ง
  const target=previous && previous.key===SAVE_KEYS[0]?SAVE_KEYS[1]:SAVE_KEYS[0];
  localStorage.setItem(target,JSON.stringify(envelope));
  // ตรวจว่าข้อมูลที่เพิ่งเขียนสามารถอ่านกลับและตรวจ checksum ได้
  const verified=readSave(target);
  if(!verified || verified.savedAt!==envelope.savedAt) throw new Error("ตรวจสอบข้อมูลหลังบันทึกไม่ผ่าน");
  saveNotice="บันทึกอัตโนมัติแล้ว";
  const status=document.getElementById("saveStatus");
  if(status) status.textContent="บันทึกล่าสุด: "+new Date(envelope.savedAt).toLocaleTimeString("th-TH");
  return true;
 }catch(error){
  console.warn("บันทึกเกมไม่สำเร็จ",error);
  saveNotice="บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ";
  const status=document.getElementById("saveStatus");
  if(status) status.textContent="บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ กรุณาส่งออกไฟล์สำรอง";
  return false;
 }
}
function persist(){saveGame();}
function loadGame(){
 const found=loadBestSave(); if(!found)return false;
 const saved=found.envelope;
 const d=saved.data; data={...d.profile,cleared:[...d.profile.cleared],knowledge:Array.isArray(d.profile.knowledge)?d.profile.knowledge:[]};
 leaderboardData=Array.isArray(d.leaderboard)?d.leaderboard:[];
 if(d.session.active){
  const s=d.session; currentStage=s.stage; questions=s.questions; index=s.index; score=s.score; correct=s.correct; lives=s.lives; tqMaxHealth=tqPlayerMaxHP();tqHealth=Number.isFinite(s.tqHealth)?Math.max(0,Math.min(tqMaxHealth,s.tqHealth)):Math.min(tqMaxHealth,s.lives/3*tqMaxHealth);
  tqCarryHealth=Number.isFinite(s.carryHealth)?Math.max(0,Math.min(tqMaxHealth,s.carryHealth)):tqHealth;
  tqUpdateLifeState(); enemyDamageTotal=Number.isFinite(s.enemyDamageTotal)?Math.max(0,s.enemyDamageTotal):0; enemyMaxHP=Number.isFinite(s.enemyMaxHP)?Math.max(1,s.enemyMaxHP):100;
  tqReviewQueue=Array.isArray(s.reviewQueue)?s.reviewQueue:[];
  tqReviewMode=!!s.reviewMode;
  tqReviewAttempts=s.reviewAttempts||{};
  tqUnresolved=new Set(Array.isArray(s.unresolved)?s.unresolved:[]);
  tqBaseQuestionCount=Number.isInteger(s.baseQuestionCount)?s.baseQuestionCount:(stages[currentStage].isBoss?5:3);
  skillUses={scan:0,boost:0,heal:0,...(s.skillUses||{})};
  for(const k of ["scan","boost","heal"])skillUses[k]=typeof skillUses[k]==="boolean"?(skillUses[k]?1:0):Math.max(0,Math.min(2,skillUses[k]));
  scanActiveIndex=Number.isInteger(s.scanActiveIndex)?s.scanActiveIndex:-1;
  document.getElementById("difficulty").value=s.difficulty;
  restoreSessionTime=s.time;
  restoreSessionAnswered=s.answered;
  restoreSessionChoice=s.choice;
  answered=s.answered;
  lastChoice=s.choice;
 }
 return true;
}

let restoreSessionAnswered=false;
let restoreSessionChoice=null;
window.addEventListener("pagehide",()=>{saveGame();});

document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",()=>{if(document.visibilityState==="hidden")saveGame();});
// บันทึกสำรองเป็นระยะ เผื่อผู้ใช้ปิดแท็บหรือเบราว์เซอร์กะทันหัน
setInterval(()=>{saveGame();},10000);

function getDifficultyInfo(){
 const mode=document.getElementById("difficulty")?.value||"easy";
 const base={easy:45,normal:40,hard:35,expert:30}[mode]||45;
 const baseLevel={easy:1,normal:2,hard:3,expert:4}[mode]||1;
 const clearedCount=Math.min(TOTAL_FLOORS,data.cleared.length);
 const level=baseLevel+clearedCount;
 // ทุกชั้นที่เคลียร์สำเร็จจะเพิ่มระดับความยาก 1 ระดับ
 const seconds=Math.max(12,base-(clearedCount*0.65));
 const multiplier=({easy:1,normal:1.25,hard:1.6,expert:2}[mode]||1)*(1+clearedCount*0.04);
 return {mode,base,baseLevel,clearedCount,level,seconds,multiplier};
}
function tqPlayerMaxHP(){return 200+50*(level()-1);}
function tqPlayerDamage(){return Math.max(1,Math.round(15*Math.pow(1.06,level()-1)));}
function tqBossHP(){return ({easy:260,normal:310,hard:420,expert:540})[getDifficultyInfo().mode]||260;}
function tqBossDamage(){return Math.max(1,Math.round(20*Math.pow(1.08,getDifficultyInfo().level-1)));}
function tqNormalEnemyDamage(){
 const tier=Math.max(1,getDifficultyInfo().level);
 return Math.max(1,Math.round(7*Math.pow(1.04,tier-1)));
}
function tqUpdateLifeState(){lives=tqHealth<=0?0:Math.max(1,Math.ceil(tqHealth/tqMaxHealth*maxLives));}
function updateDifficultyDisplay(){
 const el=document.getElementById("difficultyProgress");
 if(!el)return;
 const d=getDifficultyInfo();
 el.textContent=`ความยากปัจจุบัน: ระดับ ${d.level} • ผ่านแล้ว ${d.clearedCount} ชั้น • เวลาเริ่มต้นชั้นถัดไปประมาณ ${Math.ceil(d.seconds)} วินาที • ตัวคูณคะแนน x${d.multiplier.toFixed(2)}`;
}

function level(){
 let xp=data.xp,lv=1,need=100;
 while(xp>=need){
  xp-=need;
  lv++;
  need+=100;
 }
 return lv;
}

function rank(){
 let stars=data.stars,idx=0,need=100;
 while(idx<9&&stars>=need){
  stars-=need;
  idx++;
  need+=200;
 }
 return {idx,name:rankNames[idx],progress:stars,need};
}


function tqToggleSkills(force){
 const menu=document.getElementById('tqSkillMenu'),btn=document.getElementById('tqSkillToggle');
 if(!menu||!btn)return;
 const open=typeof force==='boolean'?force:menu.hidden;
 menu.hidden=!open;btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));
}
document.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
 const box=document.getElementById('tqSkillFloat');
 if(box&&!box.contains(e.target))tqToggleSkills(false);
});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')tqToggleSkills(false)});
function tqFitQuiz(){
 const game=document.getElementById('game');if(!game||!game.classList.contains('active'))return;
 game.style.zoom='1';
 const available=window.innerHeight-12;
 let scale=Math.min(1,available/Math.max(game.scrollHeight,1));
 if(scale<.99){game.style.zoom=String(Math.max(.62,scale));}
}
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>requestAnimationFrame(tqFitQuiz));

 const target=document.getElementById(id);
 if(target)target.classList.add("active");

}

   <div class="world-path">${group.map((s,j)=>{

      <span class="node-number">${boss?iconSvg("crown",19):String(i+1).padStart(2,"0")}</span>
      <b>${s.name}</b><small>${s.monster.name}</small>
      <em>${done?"ผ่านแล้ว":locked?"ล็อกอยู่":boss?"ด่านบอส":"เล่นด่านนี้"}</em>
    </button>`;
  }).join("")}</div></section>`;
 }).join("");
}

function startStage(i){
 if(i<0||i>=data.unlocked||i>=stages.length)return;
 tqCarryHealth=null;
 data.name=document.getElementById("playerName").value.trim()||"นักสำรวจ";
 persist();
 friendMode=false;
 currentStage=i;
 beginTurn();
}

function getQuestions(){
 // ประวัติแยกตามหมวด: ใช้คำถามที่ยังไม่เคยออกก่อน จนครบคลังแล้วจึงเริ่มรอบใหม่
 const themeIndex=Math.floor(currentStage/5)%baseStages.length;
 const floorKey=`techQuestQuestionHistory_v2_theme_${themeIndex}`;
 const pool=[...stages[currentStage].questions];
 const questionId=q=>q[0].replace(/^ชั้น \d+ • [^:]+: /,'');
 const shuffle=a=>{for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]];}return a;};
 let seen=[];
 try{seen=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(floorKey)||'[]');if(!Array.isArray(seen))seen=[];}catch{seen=[];}
 const unseen=pool.filter(q=>!seen.includes(questionId(q)));
 let source=unseen;
 const lastQuestions=window.tqLastFloorQuestions||[];
 const fresh=source.filter(q=>!lastQuestions.includes(questionId(q)));
 if(fresh.length>=tqQuestionLimit())source=fresh;
 // ถ้าคลังหมวดนี้ถูกใช้ครบแล้ว ให้เริ่มรอบใหม่จากคลังทั้งหมด
 if(source.length<tqQuestionLimit()){source=pool;seen=[];}
 const selected=shuffle([...source]).slice(0,tqQuestionLimit());
 window.tqLastFloorQuestions=selected.map(questionId);
 const nextSeen=[...new Set([...seen,...selected.map(questionId)])];
 try{localStorage.setItem(floorKey,JSON.stringify(nextSeen.length>=pool.length?[]:nextSeen));}catch{}
 return selected.map(q=>{
  let opts=shuffle(q[1].map((v,i)=>({v,correct:i===q[2]})));
  return [q[0],opts.map(o=>o.v),opts.findIndex(o=>o.correct)];
 });
}


const tqPixelMonsters=["data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,", "data:image/png;base64,"];
function tqUpdateFloorScene(){
 const floor=currentStage+1;
 const zone=Math.floor(currentStage/5)+1;
 const dungeon=document.getElementById('enemyPanel');
 if(dungeon){dungeon.style.setProperty('--tq-dungeon-bg','url("'+tqDungeonBackgrounds[0]+'")');dungeon.style.setProperty('--tq-forest-bg','url("'+tqDungeonBackgrounds[1]+'")');}

 const zoneNames=['ป่ารุ่งอรุณ','ถ้ำคริสตัล','วิหารโบราณ','หุบเขาเพลิง','ป่าหมอก','ปราสาทน้ำแข็ง','เขาวงกต','หอคอยสายฟ้า','แดนเงา','บัลลังก์สุดท้าย'];
 const scene=document.querySelector('#enemyPanel .battle-stage');
 if(scene){scene.classList.remove('tq-forest','tq-fire','tq-ice','tq-void');scene.classList.add(zone<=3?'tq-forest':zone<=5?'tq-fire':zone<=7?'tq-ice':'tq-void');}
 const now=document.getElementById('tqFloorNow');if(now)now.textContent='ชั้น '+floor+' / '+stages.length+(stages[currentStage].isBoss?' • BOSS':'');
 const progress=document.getElementById('tqFloorProgress');if(progress)progress.style.width=(floor/stages.length*100)+'%';
 const name=document.getElementById('tqZoneNow');if(name)name.textContent='เขต '+zone+' • '+zoneNames[zone-1];
}
let tqFloorTransitionBusy=false;
function tqEnterNextFloor(next){
 if(tqFloorTransitionBusy)return;
 tqFloorTransitionBusy=true;
 const overlay=document.getElementById('tqFloorTransition');
 const label=document.getElementById('tqFloorTransitionLabel');
 if(label)label.textContent='กำลังเข้าสู่ชั้น '+(next+1);
 if(overlay)overlay.classList.add('active');
 setTimeout(()=>{
  currentStage=next;beginTurn();
  setTimeout(()=>{if(overlay)overlay.classList.remove('active');tqFloorTransitionBusy=false},500);
 },1300);
}

function tqQuestionLimit(){return friendMode?9:(stages[currentStage].isBoss?5:3)}
function tqWinTarget(){return stages[currentStage].isBoss?4:2}
function beginTurn(){
 questions=getQuestions();
 tqReviewQueue=[];tqReviewMode=false;tqReviewAttempts={};tqUnresolved=new Set();tqBaseQuestionCount=questions.length;
 clearTimeout(correctAdvanceTimer); activeFloorPerk=floorPerk;floorPerk=null;index=0;score=0;correct=0;enemyDamageTotal=0;enemyMaxHP=stages[currentStage].isBoss?tqBossHP():Math.round(55*Math.pow(1.04,getDifficultyInfo().level-1));maxLives=activeFloorPerk==="vitality"?4:3;
 tqMaxHealth=tqPlayerMaxHP();
 tqHealth=tqCarryHealth===null?tqMaxHealth:Math.min(tqMaxHealth,Math.max(1,tqCarryHealth));
 tqCarryHealth=null;tqUpdateLifeState();skillUses={scan:0,boost:0,heal:0};scanActiveIndex=-1;answered=false;lastChoice=null;restoreSessionAnswered=false;restoreSessionChoice=null;
 show("game");
 tqUpdateFloorScene();
 renderQuestion();
 playActorAnimation("playerActor","walk",900);
 playActorAnimation("enemyActor","walk",900);
}

function renderQuestion(){
 clearInterval(timer);
 try{playActorAnimation("playerActor","idle");playActorAnimation("enemyActor","idle");}catch(e){console.warn("Animation error",e);}
 answered=false;
 lastChoice=null;
 const difficultyInfo=getDifficultyInfo();
 time=Math.max(12,Math.ceil(difficultyInfo.seconds))+(activeFloorPerk==="time"?10:0);
 if(restoreSessionTime!==null){time=Math.max(0,Math.min(time,restoreSessionTime));restoreSessionTime=null;}
 const floorData=stages[currentStage];
 const playerArt=document.getElementById("playerBattleArt");
 const homeArt=document.querySelector(".hero-art");
 if(playerArt)playerArt.src=tqHeroSprites[0][tqSelectedHero];
 const playerLabel=document.getElementById("playerActorName");
 if(playerLabel)playerLabel.textContent=friendMode?friendPlayers[friendTurn]:(tqHeroNames[tqSelectedHero]+" • "+(data.name||"Tech Hero"));
 document.getElementById("stageTitle").textContent=
 (friendMode?friendPlayers[friendTurn]+" • ":"")+`ชั้น ${currentStage+1} • ความยาก Lv.${getDifficultyInfo().level} • `+floorData.name+(floorData.isBoss?" • BOSS":"");
 const enemyName=document.getElementById("enemyName"), enemyDesc=document.getElementById("enemyDesc");
 if(enemyName)enemyName.textContent=`${floorData.isBoss?"BOSS: ":"มอนสเตอร์: "}${floorData.monster.name}`;
 const enemyArt=document.getElementById("enemyArt"); if(enemyArt){enemyArt.src=tqPixelMonsters[floorData.isBoss?5:Math.floor(currentStage/5)%4+1]; enemyArt.alt=(floorData.isBoss?"บอส ":"มอนสเตอร์ ")+floorData.monster.name;}
 if(enemyDesc)enemyDesc.textContent=floorData.isBoss?"ห้องบอส! ต้องโจมตีจน HP บอสเหลือ 0 จึงผ่านด่าน":"ต้องโจมตีจน HP มอนสเตอร์เหลือ 0 จึงผ่านด่าน";
 const enemyBar=document.getElementById("enemyBar"); if(enemyBar)enemyBar.style.width=Math.max(0,100-(enemyDamageTotal/enemyMaxHP)*100)+"%";
 const enemyHpText=document.getElementById("enemyHpText");if(enemyHpText)enemyHpText.textContent=Math.max(0,enemyMaxHP-enemyDamageTotal)+"/"+enemyMaxHP;
 const diceResult=document.getElementById("diceResult");if(diceResult&&!answered){diceResult.className="dice-result";diceResult.innerHTML='<span class="dice-cube">?</span><span><b>ลูกเต๋าพร้อมทอย</b><small>ตอบถูกโจมตี • ตอบผิดศัตรูสวนกลับ</small></span>';}
 const objectiveTitle=document.getElementById("objectiveTitle");
 const objectiveHint=document.getElementById("objectiveHint");
 if(objectiveTitle)objectiveTitle.textContent=floorData.isBoss?"ภารกิจปราบบอส":"ภารกิจต่อสู้";
 if(objectiveHint)objectiveHint.textContent=floorData.isBoss?"บอส HP "+Math.max(0,enemyMaxHP-enemyDamageTotal)+"/"+enemyMaxHP+" • ตอบถูกเพื่อโจมตี":"ตอบถูกเพื่อโจมตีจนศัตรู HP เหลือ 0 • ตอบผิดเสีย HP";
 updateSkillButtons();
 document.getElementById("score").textContent=score;
 document.getElementById("time").textContent=time;
 document.getElementById("timebar").style.width="100%";
 document.getElementById("progress").textContent=(tqReviewMode?`ทบทวนข้อผิด (${tqReviewQueue.length+1} ข้อคงเหลือ)`:`ข้อ ${index+1} • HP ศัตรู ${Math.max(0,enemyMaxHP-enemyDamageTotal)}/${enemyMaxHP}`);
 document.getElementById("hp").innerHTML=renderHP();
 document.getElementById("question").textContent=questions[index][0];
 document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="เลือกคำตอบเพื่อดำเนินการต่อสู้";
 document.getElementById("next").classList.add("hidden");

 document.getElementById("answers").innerHTML=questions[index][1].map((a,i)=>
 `<button class="answer" onclick="answer(${i})">${["A","B","C","D"][i]}. ${a}</button>`
 ).join("");
 if(scanActiveIndex===index){
  const correctIndex=questions[index][2];
  [...document.querySelectorAll(".answer")].filter((b,i)=>i!==correctIndex).slice(0,2).forEach(b=>{b.disabled=true;b.style.opacity=".3";b.textContent+=" — ตัดตัวเลือก";});
 }

 if(restoreSessionAnswered){
  answered=true;
  const buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll(".answer")];
  buttons.forEach((b,i)=>{b.disabled=true;if(i===questions[index][2])b.classList.add("correct");if(i===restoreSessionChoice&&i!==questions[index][2])b.classList.add("wrong");});
  document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="กู้คืนคำตอบที่บันทึกไว้แล้ว กดข้อต่อไปเพื่อเล่นต่อ";
  document.getElementById("next").classList.remove("hidden");
  document.getElementById("next").innerHTML=(tqHealth<=0||(enemyDamageTotal>=enemyMaxHP&&tqReviewQueue.length===0&&tqUnresolved.size===0))?iconSvg("check")+" ดูผลลัพธ์":iconSvg("arrow")+" ข้อต่อไป";
  restoreSessionAnswered=false; restoreSessionChoice=null;
  saveGame();
  correctAdvanceTimer=setTimeout(()=>{if(answered)nextQuestion();},850);
  return;
 }
 timer=setInterval(()=>{
  time--;
  document.getElementById("time").textContent=time;
  document.getElementById("timebar").style.width=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,time/(Math.max(12,Math.ceil(getDifficultyInfo().seconds))+(activeFloorPerk==="time"?10:0))*100))+"%";
  if(time%5===0)saveGame();
  if(time<=0)answer(-1);
 },1000);
 saveGame();
}

function updateSkillButtons(){
 const labels={scan:["scan","วิเคราะห์คำตอบ"],boost:["zap","เร่งเวลา +10 วิ"],heal:["heart","ฟื้นฟู HP +10%"]};
 for(const key of Object.keys(labels)){
  const btn=document.getElementById(key==="scan"?"skillScan":key==="boost"?"skillBoost":"skillHeal");
  const used=skillUses[key]||0, remaining=Math.max(0,2-used);
  if(btn){
   btn.disabled=remaining===0||answered||(key==="heal"&&tqHealth>=tqMaxHealth);
   btn.innerHTML=`<span class="skill-label">${iconSvg(labels[key][0])}<span>${labels[key][1]}</span></span><small>เหลือ ${remaining}/2 ครั้ง/ชั้น</small>`;
  }
 }
 const status=document.getElementById("skillStatus");if(status)status.textContent=`จำนวนครั้งที่ใช้: วิเคราะห์ ${skillUses.scan||0}/2 • เร่งเวลา ${skillUses.boost||0}/2 • ฟื้นฟู ${skillUses.heal||0}/2`;
}
function useSkill(type){
 if(answered||!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(skillUses,type)||(skillUses[type]||0)>=2)return;
 if(type==="scan"){
  const correctIndex=questions[index][2];
  const wrong=[...document.querySelectorAll(".answer")].filter((b,i)=>i!==correctIndex&&!b.disabled);
  wrong.slice(0,2).forEach(b=>{b.disabled=true;b.style.opacity=".3";b.textContent+=" — ตัดตัวเลือก";});
  scanActiveIndex=index;
  document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="วิเคราะห์แล้ว: ตัดตัวเลือกที่ไม่ถูกต้องออก 2 ข้อ (มีผลกับข้อนี้เท่านั้น)";
 }else if(type==="boost"){
  time=Math.min(60,time+10);document.getElementById("time").textContent=time;
  document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="เร่งพลังสำเร็จ! เพิ่มเวลา 10 วินาที";
 }else if(type==="heal"){
  if(tqHealth>=tqMaxHealth)return;tqHealth=Math.min(tqMaxHealth,tqHealth+Math.ceil(tqMaxHealth*.10));tqUpdateLifeState();
  document.getElementById("hp").innerHTML=renderHP();
  document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="ฟื้นฟูพลังชีวิต +10% ของ HP สูงสุด";
 }
 skillUses[type]=(skillUses[type]||0)+1;updateSkillButtons();saveGame();
}

function answer(choice){
 if(answered)return;
 answered=true;
 lastChoice=choice;
 clearInterval(timer);
 let q=questions[index];
 if(!tqReviewMode&&choice!==q[2]&&!tqReviewQueue.some(x=>x[0]===q[0])){tqReviewQueue.push(q);tqUnresolved.add(q[0]);}
 if(tqReviewMode&&choice===q[2])tqUnresolved.delete(q[0]);
 if(tqReviewMode&&choice!==q[2]){const key=q[0];tqReviewAttempts[key]=(tqReviewAttempts[key]||0)+1;tqReviewQueue.push(q);}
 let buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll(".answer")];

 buttons.forEach((b,i)=>{
  b.disabled=true;
  if(i===q[2])b.classList.add("correct");
  if(i===choice&&choice!==q[2])b.classList.add("wrong");
 });

 const diceResult=document.getElementById("diceResult");
 if(choice===q[2]){
  const roll=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*6),isCritical=roll===6;
  let damage=Math.max(1,Math.round(tqPlayerDamage()*(isCritical?1.5:1)));
  enemyDamageTotal=Math.min(enemyMaxHP,enemyDamageTotal+damage);
  try{playActorAnimation("playerActor","attack",520);playActorAnimation("enemyActor","hurt",440);}catch(e){console.warn("Animation error",e);}
  correct++;
  let multiplier=getDifficultyInfo().multiplier;
  if(activeFloorPerk==="power")multiplier*=1.25;
  let gained=Math.round((10+Math.ceil(time/4))*multiplier);
  score+=gained;
  if(diceResult){diceResult.className="dice-result rolling "+(isCritical?"critical":"hit");diceResult.innerHTML='<span class="dice-cube">'+roll+'</span><span><b>'+(isCritical?'CRITICAL! คริติคอล':'ทอย D6 ได้ '+roll+' แต้ม')+'</b><small>ผู้เล่นโจมตี '+damage+' ดาเมจ</small></span>';}
  document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="โจมตีโดน "+damage+" ดาเมจ! • +"+gained+" คะแนน";
 }else{
  const roll=1+Math.floor(Math.random()*4);
  const damage=stages[currentStage].isBoss?tqBossDamage():tqNormalEnemyDamage();
  try{playActorAnimation("enemyActor","attack",520);playActorAnimation("playerActor","hurt",440);}catch(e){console.warn("Animation error",e);}
  tqHealth=Math.max(0,tqHealth-damage);tqUpdateLifeState();
  if(diceResult){diceResult.className="dice-result rolling damage";diceResult.innerHTML='<span class="dice-cube">'+roll+'</span><span><b>มอนสเตอร์โจมตี</b><small>เสีย HP '+damage+' • คงเหลือ '+Math.round(tqHealth)+'/'+tqMaxHealth+'</small></span>';}
  document.getElementById("feedback").textContent=choice===-1?"หมดเวลา! มอนสเตอร์สวนกลับ สร้าง "+damage+" ดาเมจ":"ตอบผิด! มอนสเตอร์สวนกลับ สร้าง "+damage+" ดาเมจ";
  if(!friendMode) recordKnowledgeMistake(q,choice);
 }
 document.getElementById("score").textContent=score;
 const enemyBar=document.getElementById("enemyBar"); if(enemyBar)enemyBar.style.width=Math.max(0,100-(enemyDamageTotal/enemyMaxHP)*100)+"%";
 const enemyHpText=document.getElementById("enemyHpText");if(enemyHpText)enemyHpText.textContent=Math.max(0,enemyMaxHP-enemyDamageTotal)+"/"+enemyMaxHP;
 document.getElementById("hp").innerHTML=renderHP();
 document.getElementById("next").classList.remove("hidden");
 updateSkillButtons();
 document.getElementById("next").innerHTML=(tqHealth<=0||(enemyDamageTotal>=enemyMaxHP&&tqReviewQueue.length===0&&tqUnresolved.size===0))?iconSvg("check")+" ดูผลลัพธ์":iconSvg("arrow")+" ข้อต่อไป";
 document.getElementById("feedback").textContent+=" • กำลังดำเนินการ...";
 saveGame();
 correctAdvanceTimer=setTimeout(()=>{if(answered)nextQuestion();},850);
}

let tqReviewQueue=[],tqReviewMode=false,tqReviewAttempts={},tqUnresolved=new Set(),tqBaseQuestionCount=0;
function nextQuestion(){
 clearTimeout(correctAdvanceTimer);
 if(!answered)return;
 if(tqHealth<=0){finish();return;}
 // Review wrong answers after the original batch; continue battle until enemy HP reaches zero.
 const enemyDead=enemyDamageTotal>=enemyMaxHP;
 if(!enemyDead && !tqReviewMode && index<tqBaseQuestionCount-1 && index+1<questions.length){
   index++;answered=false;lastChoice=null;scanActiveIndex=-1;renderQuestion();return;
 }
 if(tqReviewQueue.length){
   tqReviewMode=true;
   const retry=tqReviewQueue.shift();
   questions.push(retry);
   index=questions.length-1;answered=false;lastChoice=null;scanActiveIndex=-1;
   renderQuestion();return;
 }
 if(enemyDead && tqUnresolved.size===0){finish();return;}
 // Do not end the floor after the first batch. Keep asking new questions.
 const pool=(stages[currentStage].questions||[]).length?stages[currentStage].questions:getQuestions();
 const used=new Set(questions.slice(-Math.min(25,questions.length)).map(q=>q[0]));
 let candidates=pool.filter(q=>!used.has(q[0]));
 if(!candidates.length)candidates=pool;
 if(!candidates.length){document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="ไม่พบคำถามสำหรับด่านนี้";document.getElementById("next").classList.remove("hidden");return;}
 const q=candidates[Math.floor(Math.random()*candidates.length)];
 const options=q[1].map((value,i)=>({value,correct:i===q[2]}));
 for(let i=options.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));[options[i],options[j]]=[options[j],options[i]];}
 questions.push([q[0],options.map(x=>x.value),options.findIndex(x=>x.correct)]);
 index=questions.length-1;
 tqReviewMode=false;answered=false;lastChoice=null;scanActiveIndex=-1;
 renderQuestion();
}

function tqShowFloorVictory(floor,stars,xp){
 const layer=document.getElementById('tqVictoryOverlay');
 if(!layer)return;
 layer.querySelector('.tq-victory-title').textContent='ผ่านชั้น '+floor+' สำเร็จ!';
 layer.querySelector('.tq-victory-reward').textContent='+'+xp+' EXP • '+stars+' ดาว';
 layer.classList.remove('active');
 void layer.offsetWidth;
 layer.classList.add('active');
 const burst=layer.querySelector('.tq-victory-bursts');
 if(burst){
   burst.replaceChildren();
   const colors=['#ffd16b','#f28bb2','#8ce4e0','#ffffff','#bba1ff'];
   for(let i=0;i<42;i++){
     const piece=document.createElement('i');piece.className='tq-confetti';
     piece.style.setProperty('--x',(3+Math.random()*94)+'%');
     piece.style.setProperty('--w',(5+Math.random()*7)+'px');
     piece.style.setProperty('--h',(7+Math.random()*12)+'px');
     piece.style.setProperty('--c',colors[i%colors.length]);
     piece.style.setProperty('--duration',(1.1+Math.random()*.9)+'s');
     piece.style.setProperty('--delay',(Math.random()*.38)+'s');
     piece.style.setProperty('--drift',(-80+Math.random()*160)+'px');
     piece.style.setProperty('--spin',(-720+Math.random()*1440)+'deg');
     burst.appendChild(piece);
   }
 }
 clearTimeout(window.tqVictoryTimeout);
 window.tqVictoryTimeout=setTimeout(()=>layer.classList.remove('active'),2200);
}
function finish(){
 clearInterval(timer);clearTimeout(correctAdvanceTimer);clearInterval(perkTimer);

 if(friendMode){
  friendScores.push({name:friendPlayers[friendTurn],score,correct});
  if(friendTurn===0){
   friendTurn=1;
   alert("ส่งเครื่องให้ "+friendPlayers[1]+" เล่นได้เลย");
   beginTurn();
   return;
  }
  let a=friendScores[0],b=friendScores[1];
  document.getElementById("resultTitle").textContent=
   a.score===b.score?"เสมอกัน":a.score>b.score?a.name+" ชนะ!":b.name+" ชนะ!";
  document.getElementById("resultText").innerHTML=
   `${a.name}: ${a.score} คะแนน (${a.correct}/9)<br>${b.name}: ${b.score} คะแนน (${b.correct}/9)`;
  document.getElementById("resultScore").textContent=Math.max(a.score,b.score);
  document.getElementById("resultXP").textContent="โหมดเพื่อน";
  document.getElementById("resultCorrect").textContent=a.correct+"/"+b.correct;
  friendMode=false;
  show("result");
  return;
 }

 let won=tqHealth>0&&enemyDamageTotal>=enemyMaxHP&&tqUnresolved.size===0;
 let xp=won?score+30:Math.floor(score/2);
 let stars=won?Math.max(1,Math.floor(score/2)):0;

 data.xp+=xp;
 data.stars+=stars;

 if(won&&!data.cleared.includes(currentStage)){
  data.cleared.push(currentStage);
 }
 if(won)data.unlocked=Math.max(data.unlocked,Math.min(stages.length,currentStage+2));

 persist();
 update();
 updateDifficultyDisplay();

 if(won){tqCarryHealth=Math.min(tqMaxHealth,Math.ceil(tqHealth*1.10));tqShowFloorVictory(currentStage+1,stars,xp);}
 document.getElementById("resultTitle").textContent=won?(currentStage===stages.length-1?"พิชิตยอดหอคอยสำเร็จ!":"ผ่านชั้นสำเร็จ!"):"ลองอีกครั้ง";
 document.getElementById("resultText").textContent=
 `ได้รับ ${stars} ดาว • แรงก์ ${rank().name}`+(won?` • ความยากเพิ่มเป็นระดับ ${getDifficultyInfo().level}`:``);
 document.getElementById("resultScore").textContent=score;
 document.getElementById("resultXP").textContent="+"+xp;
 document.getElementById("resultCorrect").textContent=correct+"/"+questions.length;
 show("result");
 if(won && currentStage<stages.length-1){startPerkSelection();}
 else {document.getElementById("perkPanel").classList.add("hidden");floorPerk=null;}
}

function startPerkSelection(){
 clearInterval(perkTimer);selectedPerk=null;perkSeconds=35;
 const panel=document.getElementById("perkPanel");panel.classList.remove("hidden");
 document.getElementById("perkCountdown").textContent=perkSeconds;
 document.getElementById("perkChosen").textContent="ยังไม่ได้เลือกสกิล";
 document.getElementById("continueTower").disabled=true;
 document.querySelectorAll(".perk-option").forEach(b=>b.classList.remove("selected"));
 perkTimer=setInterval(()=>{
  perkSeconds--;document.getElementById("perkCountdown").textContent=perkSeconds;
  if(perkSeconds<=0){clearInterval(perkTimer);if(!selectedPerk)selectedPerk="time";applySelectedPerk();continueTower();}
 },1000);
}
function choosePerk(type){
 if(!["time","vitality","power"].includes(type))return;
 selectedPerk=type;
 document.querySelectorAll(".perk-option").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("selected",b.dataset.perk===type));
 const names={time:"พลังเร่งเวลา",vitality:"พลังชีวิตพิเศษ",power:"พลังคะแนน"};
 document.getElementById("perkChosen").textContent="เลือกแล้ว: "+names[type];
 document.getElementById("continueTower").disabled=false;
}
function applySelectedPerk(){
 if(!selectedPerk)return;
 floorPerk=selectedPerk;
 const names={time:"พลังเร่งเวลา",vitality:"พลังชีวิตพิเศษ",power:"พลังคะแนน"};
 document.getElementById("perkChosen").textContent="ได้รับ "+names[selectedPerk]+" สำหรับชั้นถัดไป";
}
function continueTower(){
 if(!selectedPerk)return;
 clearInterval(perkTimer);applySelectedPerk();
 const next=currentStage+1;
 if(next>=stages.length){mapScreen();return;}
 tqEnterNextFloor(next);
}

function quitGame(){
 clearInterval(timer);clearTimeout(correctAdvanceTimer);clearInterval(perkTimer);
 friendMode=false;
 persist();
 mapScreen();
}

function friendGame(){
 let a=prompt("ชื่อผู้เล่นคนที่ 1","ผู้เล่น 1");
 if(!a)return;
 let b=prompt("ชื่อผู้เล่นคนที่ 2","ผู้เล่น 2");
 if(!b)return;
 if(a.trim().toLowerCase()===b.trim().toLowerCase()){
  alert("ใช้ชื่อที่แตกต่างกัน");
  return;
 }
 let st=Number(prompt("เลือกชั้น 1-50","1"));
 if(st<1||st>TOTAL_FLOORS||!Number.isInteger(st))return;
 friendMode=true;
 friendPlayers=[a.trim(),b.trim()];
 friendScores=[];
 friendTurn=0;
 currentStage=st-1;
 beginTurn();
}

function leaderboard(){
 clearInterval(timer);
 let list=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("techLeaderboard")||"[]");
 let found=list.find(x=>x.name===data.name);
 if(found){
  found.xp=data.xp;found.stars=data.stars;found.rank=rank().name;
 }else{
  list.push({name:data.name,xp:data.xp,stars:data.stars,rank:rank().name});
 }
 localStorage.setItem("techLeaderboard",JSON.stringify(list));
 list.sort((a,b)=>b.xp-a.xp);
 leaderboardData=list;
 saveGame();
 document.getElementById("leaderRows").innerHTML=list.slice(0,10).map((x,i)=>
 `<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td>${x.name}</td><td>${x.rank}</td><td>${x.xp}</td></tr>`
 ).join("");
 show("rankboard");
}

function resetGame(){
 if(!confirm("ต้องการรีเซ็ตความคืบหน้าหรือไม่?"))return;
 data={name:"นักสำรวจ",xp:0,stars:0,unlocked:1,cleared:[],knowledge:[]};
 SAVE_KEYS.forEach(k=>{try{localStorage.removeItem(k);}catch{}});
 persist();
 update();
 homeScreen();
}

];
let knowledgeTab="all";
function escapeKnowledge(value){return String(value??"").replace(/[&<>"']/g,ch=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[ch]));}
function classifyKnowledge(question){
 const q=String(question).toLowerCase();
 if(/ไวรัส|มัลแวร์|รหัสผ่าน|ฟิชชิง|phishing|ความปลอดภัย|firewall|ไฟร์วอลล์|แฮก/.test(q))return "ความปลอดภัยไซเบอร์";
 if(/ปัญญาประดิษฐ์|\bai\b|machine learning|deep learning|แชตบอต/.test(q))return "AI";
 if(/html|css|javascript|python|โปรแกรม|อัลกอริทึม|algorithm|loop|ตัวแปร|debug/.test(q))return "การเขียนโปรแกรม";
 if(/อินเทอร์เน็ต|internet|เว็บไซต์|เว็บ|url|wifi|wi-fi|เครือข่าย|network|browser|เบราว์เซอร์/.test(q))return "อินเทอร์เน็ต";
 if(/cpu|ram|rom|ฮาร์ดแวร์|ซอฟต์แวร์|คอมพิวเตอร์|หน่วยความจำ|ระบบปฏิบัติการ/.test(q))return "คอมพิวเตอร์";
 return "เทคโนโลยีทั่วไป";
}
function recordKnowledgeMistake(q,choice){
 if(!Array.isArray(data.knowledge))data.knowledge=[];
 const question=String(q[0]||"");
 const correctAnswer=String(q[1][q[2]]||"");
 const selectedAnswer=choice>=0?String(q[1][choice]||""):("หมดเวลา");
 let item=data.knowledge.find(x=>x.question===question);
 if(item){item.wrongCount=(item.wrongCount||1)+1;item.selectedAnswer=selectedAnswer;item.reviewed=false;item.lastWrongAt=Date.now();}
 else {
  const category=classifyKnowledge(question);
  const hints={"คอมพิวเตอร์":"ทบทวนหน้าที่ของอุปกรณ์และส่วนประกอบคอมพิวเตอร์แต่ละชนิด","อินเทอร์เน็ต":"ทบทวนการเชื่อมต่อเครือข่ายและการทำงานของบริการบนเว็บ","ความปลอดภัยไซเบอร์":"ทบทวนวิธีป้องกันข้อมูลส่วนตัวและสังเกตความเสี่ยงออนไลน์","AI":"ทบทวนหลักการทำงานและข้อจำกัดของปัญญาประดิษฐ์","การเขียนโปรแกรม":"ทบทวนแนวคิดการเขียนคำสั่งและลำดับขั้นตอนแก้ปัญหา","เทคโนโลยีทั่วไป":"ทบทวนความหมายและการใช้งานของเทคโนโลยีที่เกี่ยวข้อง"};
  data.knowledge.push({question,options:[...q[1]],correctAnswer,selectedAnswer,category,wrongCount:1,reviewed:false,lastWrongAt:Date.now(),explanation:"คำตอบที่ถูกต้องคือ “"+correctAnswer+"” "+(hints[category]||hints["เทคโนโลยีทั่วไป"])+" แล้วลองกลับมาทำโจทย์อีกครั้ง"});
 }
 saveGame();
}
function knowledgeScreen(){
 clearInterval(timer);clearTimeout(correctAdvanceTimer);clearInterval(perkTimer);
 previousScreen=document.querySelector(".screen.active")?.id||"home";
 show("knowledge");
 document.getElementById("knowledgeSearch").value="";
 document.getElementById("knowledgeCategory").value="ทั้งหมด";
 knowledgeTab="all";
 renderKnowledge();
}
function setKnowledgeTab(tab){knowledgeTab=tab;renderKnowledge();}
function markKnowledgeReviewed(i){
 if(!data.knowledge||!data.knowledge[i])return;
 data.knowledge[i].reviewed=true;saveGame();renderKnowledge();
}
function renderKnowledge(){
 const list=document.getElementById("knowledgeList");if(!list)return;
 const mistakes=Array.isArray(data.knowledge)?data.knowledge:[];
 const reviewed=mistakes.filter(x=>x.reviewed).length;
 document.getElementById("knowledgeTotal").textContent=knowledgeLessons.length;
 document.getElementById("knowledgeMistakes").textContent=mistakes.length;
 document.getElementById("knowledgeReviewed").textContent=reviewed;
 document.getElementById("knowledgeTabAll").classList.toggle("main",knowledgeTab==="all");
 document.getElementById("knowledgeTabWrong").classList.toggle("main",knowledgeTab==="wrong");
 const term=(document.getElementById("knowledgeSearch").value||"").trim().toLowerCase();
 const category=document.getElementById("knowledgeCategory").value;
 let html="";
 if(knowledgeTab==="all"){
  const rows=knowledgeLessons.map((x,i)=>({...x,_i:i})).filter(x=>(category==="ทั้งหมด"||x.category===category)&&(!term||[x.title,x.body,x.example,x.category].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(term)));
  html+=`<h3 class="section-title">${iconSvg("book",18)} บทเรียนความรู้ (${rows.length})</h3>`;
  html+=rows.map(x=>`<article class="knowledge-card"><span class="knowledge-tag">${iconSvg(categoryIcon(x.category),14)} ${escapeKnowledge(x.category)}</span><h3>${escapeKnowledge(x.title)}</h3><p>${escapeKnowledge(x.body)}</p><p class="knowledge-muted">ตัวอย่าง: ${escapeKnowledge(x.example)}</p></article>`).join("");
 }else{
  const rows=mistakes.map((x,i)=>({...x,_i:i})).filter(x=>(category==="ทั้งหมด"||x.category===category)&&(!term||[x.question,x.correctAnswer,x.selectedAnswer,x.category].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(term)));
  html+=`<h3 class="section-title">${iconSvg("check",18)} คำถามที่เคยตอบผิด (${rows.length})</h3>`;
  html+=rows.length?rows.map(x=>`<article class="knowledge-card"><span class="knowledge-tag">${escapeKnowledge(x.category||"เทคโนโลยีทั่วไป")}</span> <span class="knowledge-tag">ตอบผิด ${Number(x.wrongCount)||1} ครั้ง</span><h3>${escapeKnowledge(x.question)}</h3><p>คำตอบที่เลือก: <span class="wrong-answer">${escapeKnowledge(x.selectedAnswer||"หมดเวลา")}</span></p><p>คำตอบที่ถูกต้อง: <span class="knowledge-answer">${escapeKnowledge(x.correctAnswer)}</span></p><p class="knowledge-muted">${escapeKnowledge(x.explanation||"ทบทวนคำตอบที่ถูกต้องและทำความเข้าใจแนวคิดของคำถาม")}</p><div class="knowledge-actions"><button onclick="markKnowledgeReviewed(${x._i})">${x.reviewed?" ทบทวนแล้ว":"ทำเครื่องหมายว่าทบทวนแล้ว"}</button></div></article>`).join(""):`<div class="knowledge-card"><h3>ยังไม่มีคำถามที่ตอบผิด</h3><p>เมื่อเล่นเกมแล้วตอบผิด ระบบจะบันทึกคำถามไว้ที่นี่เพื่อให้กลับมาทบทวน</p></div>`;
 }
 if(!html.includes("knowledge-card")&&!html.includes("ยังไม่มี"))html+='<p class="knowledge-muted">ไม่พบข้อมูลที่ตรงกับคำค้นหา</p>';
 list.innerHTML=html;
}

function manualSave(){
 const ok=saveGame();
 const el=document.getElementById("saveStatus"); if(el)el.textContent=ok?"บันทึกเกมเรียบร้อยแล้ว":"บันทึกไม่สำเร็จ กรุณาตรวจสอบพื้นที่จัดเก็บ";
}
function exportSave(){
 saveGame(); const found=loadBestSave(); const best=found&&found.envelope;
 if(!best){alert("ยังไม่มีข้อมูลสำหรับส่งออก");return;}
 const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(best,null,2)],{type:"application/json"});
 const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a=document.createElement("a");
 a.href=url;a.download="TECH_QUEST_SAVE.json";document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();
 setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);
}
function importSave(event){
 const file=event.target.files&&event.target.files[0]; if(!file)return;
 const reader=new FileReader(); reader.onload=()=>{
  try{const e=JSON.parse(reader.result);if(!validEnvelope(e))throw new Error("invalid");
   localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEYS[0],JSON.stringify(e));
   localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEYS[2],JSON.stringify(e));
   loadGame();update();alert("นำเข้าข้อมูลสำเร็จ เกมจะโหลดข้อมูลที่นำเข้าแล้ว");location.reload();
  }catch{alert("ไฟล์ Save ไม่ถูกต้องหรือเสียหาย");}
 };reader.readAsText(file);event.target.value="";
}

// ===== LOCAL DEMO ACCOUNT SYSTEM =====
// This is a front-end demo only. Use a real server/auth provider for production.
const AUTH_USERS_KEY="techQuestAccounts_v1";
const AUTH_SESSION_KEY="techQuestSession_v1";
const ADMIN_EMAIL="admin@techquest.local";
const ADMIN_USERNAME="admin";
const ADMIN_PASSWORD="TQAdmin2026!";
let currentAuthUser=null;
let tqTemporaryAccounts=[];
function tqAuthStorageGet(key){
 for(const storage of [localStorage,sessionStorage]){
  try{const value=storage.getItem(key);if(value!==null)return value;}catch(e){}
 }
 return null;
}
function tqAuthStorageSet(key,value){
 let stored=false;
 for(const storage of [localStorage,sessionStorage]){
  try{storage.setItem(key,value);stored=true;}catch(e){}
 }
 return stored;
}
function readAuthUsers(){
 try{const value=JSON.parse(tqAuthStorageGet(AUTH_USERS_KEY)||"[]");return Array.isArray(value)?value:[];}
 catch{return tqTemporaryAccounts;}
}
function writeAuthUsers(users){tqTemporaryAccounts=users;if(!tqAuthStorageSet(AUTH_USERS_KEY,JSON.stringify(users)))throw Error("Storage blocked");}
function ensureAdminAccount(){
 const users=readAuthUsers();
 let admin=users.find(u=>String(u.email||"").trim().toLowerCase()===ADMIN_EMAIL);
 if(!admin){admin={name:ADMIN_USERNAME,email:ADMIN_EMAIL,password:ADMIN_PASSWORD,role:"admin"};users.push(admin);}
 else{admin.name=ADMIN_USERNAME;admin.email=ADMIN_EMAIL;admin.password=ADMIN_PASSWORD;admin.role="admin";}
 try{writeAuthUsers(users);return admin;}
 catch(error){console.warn("ไม่สามารถบันทึกบัญชีแอดมินได้",error);return admin;}
}
function isAdminUser(user=currentAuthUser){return !!user&&(user.role==="admin"||String(user.email||"").toLowerCase()===ADMIN_EMAIL);}
function updateAdminButton(){
 const btn=document.getElementById("adminTopBtn");
 if(btn)btn.style.display=isAdminUser()?"inline-flex":"none";
}
function escapeAdmin(value){return String(value??"").replace(/[&<>"']/g,ch=>({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[ch]));}
function switchAuth(mode){
 const loginForm=document.getElementById("loginForm");
 const signupForm=document.getElementById("signupForm");
 const loginMessage=document.getElementById("loginMessage");
 const signupMessage=document.getElementById("signupMessage");
 if(!loginForm||!signupForm){console.error("ไม่พบฟอร์มเข้าสู่ระบบหรือสมัครบัญชี");return;}
 const showSignup=mode==="signup";
 loginForm.classList.toggle("active",!showSignup);
 signupForm.classList.toggle("active",showSignup);
 if(loginMessage)loginMessage.textContent="";
 if(signupMessage)signupMessage.textContent="";
}
// Make auth navigation available to inline buttons and bind it explicitly as a fallback.
window.switchAuth=switchAuth;
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",()=>{
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-auth-target]').forEach(button=>{
  button.addEventListener("click",()=>switchAuth(button.dataset.authTarget));
 });
});
function authEnter(user){
 currentAuthUser=user;
 try{tqAuthStorageSet(AUTH_SESSION_KEY,JSON.stringify({email:user.email}));}
 catch(error){console.warn("ไม่สามารถบันทึกเซสชันได้",error);}
 if(user.name)data.name=user.name;
 updateAdminButton();
 update();
 show("home");
}
function registerAccount(){
 const msg=document.getElementById("signupMessage");
 try{
 const name=document.getElementById("signupName").value.trim();
 const email=document.getElementById("signupEmail").value.trim().toLowerCase();
 const password=document.getElementById("signupPassword").value;
 const confirm=document.getElementById("signupConfirm").value;
 msg.classList.remove("ok");
 if(name.length<2){msg.textContent="ชื่อผู้เล่นต้องมีอย่างน้อย 2 ตัวอักษร";return;}
 if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)){msg.textContent="กรุณากรอกอีเมลให้ถูกต้อง";return;}
 if(password.length<6){msg.textContent="รหัสผ่านต้องมีอย่างน้อย 6 ตัวอักษร";return;}
 if(password!==confirm){msg.textContent="รหัสผ่านทั้งสองช่องไม่ตรงกัน";return;}
 const users=readAuthUsers();
 if(users.some(u=>u.email===email)||tqTemporaryAccounts.some(u=>u.email===email)){msg.textContent="อีเมลนี้มีบัญชีแล้ว กรุณาเข้าสู่ระบบ";return;}
 const user={name,email,password,role:"player"};
 users.push(user);
 try{writeAuthUsers(users);}
 catch{tqTemporaryAccounts.push(user);msg.textContent="เข้าสู่ระบบชั่วคราวได้ แต่เบราว์เซอร์ไม่อนุญาตให้บันทึกบัญชีถาวร";}
 msg.textContent="สมัครบัญชีสำเร็จ กำลังเข้าสู่ระบบ...";
 msg.classList.add("ok");
 authEnter(user);
 }catch(error){
  console.error("สมัครบัญชีไม่สำเร็จ",error);
  if(msg)msg.textContent="เกิดข้อผิดพลาดในการสมัคร กรุณาลองเปิดไฟล์ใหม่ใน Chrome";
 }
}
window.registerAccount=registerAccount;
function loginAccount(){
 const identity=document.getElementById("loginIdentity").value.trim().toLowerCase();
 const password=document.getElementById("loginPassword").value;
 const msg=document.getElementById("loginMessage");
 msg.textContent="";
 // Re-create/repair the local demo admin before every login attempt.
 const admin=ensureAdminAccount();
 const users=readAuthUsers().concat(tqTemporaryAccounts.filter(t=>!readAuthUsers().some(u=>u.email===t.email)));
 const user=users.find(u=>{
  const email=String(u.email||"").trim().toLowerCase();
  const name=String(u.name||"").trim().toLowerCase();
  return (email===identity||name===identity)&&String(u.password||"")===password;
 });
 // Fallback for browsers that allow the game to run but block localStorage writes.
 if(!user&&identity===ADMIN_EMAIL&&password===ADMIN_PASSWORD){
  authEnter(admin||{name:ADMIN_USERNAME,email:ADMIN_EMAIL,password:ADMIN_PASSWORD,role:"admin"});
  return;
 }
 if(!user){msg.textContent="ชื่อบัญชี อีเมล หรือรหัสผ่านไม่ถูกต้อง หากใช้บัญชีแอดมิน ให้ตรวจสอบรหัสผ่านและลองเปิดไฟล์เวอร์ชันล่าสุด";return;}
 authEnter(user);
}
function logoutAccount(){
 if(!confirm("ต้องการออกจากระบบหรือไม่?"))return;
 try{localStorage.removeItem(AUTH_SESSION_KEY);}catch(e){}try{sessionStorage.removeItem(AUTH_SESSION_KEY);}catch(e){}
 currentAuthUser=null;
 updateAdminButton();
 show("authScreen");
 switchAuth("login");
}
function adminScreen(){
 if(!isAdminUser()){alert("เมนูนี้อนุญาตเฉพาะผู้ดูแลระบบ");show("home");return;}
 clearInterval(timer);clearTimeout(correctAdvanceTimer);clearInterval(perkTimer);
 renderAdminPanel();show("admin");
}
function renderAdminPanel(){
 if(!isAdminUser())return;
 const users=readAuthUsers();
 const board=(()=>{try{const x=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("techLeaderboard")||"[]");return Array.isArray(x)?x:[];}catch{return [];}})();
 document.getElementById("adminTotalUsers").textContent=users.length;
 document.getElementById("adminPlayerCount").textContent=users.filter(u=>u.role!=="admin").length;
 document.getElementById("adminAdminCount").textContent=users.filter(u=>u.role==="admin").length;
 document.getElementById("adminRankCount").textContent=board.length;
 document.getElementById("adminSignedIn").textContent="เข้าสู่ระบบ: "+(currentAuthUser?.name||ADMIN_USERNAME);
 renderAdminUsers();
}
function renderAdminUsers(){
 if(!isAdminUser())return;
 const tbody=document.getElementById("adminUserRows");if(!tbody)return;
 const term=(document.getElementById("adminUserSearch")?.value||"").trim().toLowerCase();
 const users=readAuthUsers().filter(u=>[u.name,u.email].join(" ").toLowerCase().includes(term));
 if(!users.length){tbody.innerHTML='<tr><td colspan="4"><div class="admin-empty">ไม่พบบัญชีที่ค้นหา</div></td></tr>';return;}
 tbody.innerHTML=users.map(u=>{
  const email=String(u.email||"").toLowerCase();
  const isPrimary=email===ADMIN_EMAIL;
  const isAdmin=u.role==="admin"||isPrimary;
  const self=String(currentAuthUser?.email||"").toLowerCase()===email;
  const actions=isPrimary||self?'<span class="muted">บัญชีปัจจุบัน</span>':`<div class="admin-actions"><button onclick="adminToggleRole('${escapeAdmin(email)}')">${isAdmin?"ลดสิทธิ์":"ตั้งเป็นแอดมิน"}</button><button class="admin-danger" onclick="adminDeleteUser('${escapeAdmin(email)}')">ลบบัญชี</button></div>`;
  return `<tr><td>${escapeAdmin(u.name||"ไม่ระบุ")}</td><td>${escapeAdmin(email)}</td><td><span class="admin-role ${isAdmin?"is-admin":""}">${isAdmin?"ผู้ดูแล":"ผู้เล่น"}</span></td><td>${actions}</td></tr>`;
 }).join("");
}
function adminToggleRole(email){
 if(!isAdminUser())return;
 if(email===ADMIN_EMAIL)return;
 const users=readAuthUsers(),target=users.find(u=>String(u.email||"").toLowerCase()===email);
 if(!target)return;
 const makeAdmin=target.role!=="admin";
 if(!confirm(makeAdmin?`ต้องการตั้ง ${target.name} เป็นผู้ดูแลหรือไม่?`:`ต้องการลดสิทธิ์ ${target.name} เป็นผู้เล่นหรือไม่?`))return;
 target.role=makeAdmin?"admin":"player";
 try{writeAuthUsers(users);renderAdminPanel();}catch{alert("บันทึกการเปลี่ยนสิทธิ์ไม่สำเร็จ");}
}
function adminDeleteUser(email){
 if(!isAdminUser()||email===ADMIN_EMAIL||email===String(currentAuthUser?.email||"").toLowerCase())return;
 const users=readAuthUsers(),target=users.find(u=>String(u.email||"").toLowerCase()===email);
 if(!target||!confirm(`ยืนยันลบบัญชี ${target.name||email} หรือไม่? การลบนี้ย้อนกลับไม่ได้`))return;
 try{writeAuthUsers(users.filter(u=>String(u.email||"").toLowerCase()!==email));renderAdminPanel();}
 catch{alert("ลบบัญชีไม่สำเร็จ");}
}
function adminClearLeaderboard(){
 if(!isAdminUser()||!confirm("ต้องการล้างตารางอันดับผู้เล่นทั้งหมดหรือไม่?"))return;
 localStorage.removeItem("techLeaderboard");leaderboardData=[];renderAdminPanel();
}
function adminResetGameData(){
 if(!isAdminUser()||!confirm("ต้องการรีเซ็ตความคืบหน้าเกมในเบราว์เซอร์นี้ทั้งหมดหรือไม่? บัญชีผู้ใช้จะไม่ถูกลบ"))return;
 SAVE_KEYS.forEach(k=>localStorage.removeItem(k));
 localStorage.removeItem("techLeaderboard");
 data={name:currentAuthUser?.name||"นักสำรวจ",xp:0,stars:0,unlocked:1,cleared:[],knowledge:[]};
 leaderboardData=[];update();renderAdminPanel();alert("รีเซ็ตความคืบหน้าเกมแล้ว");
}

function restoreAuthSession(){
 try{
  const session=JSON.parse(tqAuthStorageGet(AUTH_SESSION_KEY)||"null");
  if(!session||!session.email)return null;
  return readAuthUsers().find(u=>u.email===session.email)||null;
 }catch{return null;}
}


document.querySelectorAll("[data-icon]").forEach(el=>{el.innerHTML=iconSvg(el.dataset.icon,20);});

ensureAdminAccount();
const hadSave=loadGame();
update();
const signedInUser=restoreAuthSession();
currentAuthUser=signedInUser;
updateAdminButton();
if(!signedInUser){
 show("authScreen");
}else{
 if(signedInUser.name)data.name=signedInUser.name;
 update();
 if(hadSave && questions.length===9 && data.unlocked>0 && restoreSessionTime!==null){
  show("game");
  renderQuestion();
  if(!answered) document.getElementById("feedback").textContent="กู้คืนเกมแล้ว เลือกคำตอบเพื่อเล่นต่อ";
 }else{show("home");}
}


// สลับรูปแบบการจัดวางระหว่างคอมพิวเตอร์และมือถือ โดยไม่เปลี่ยนข้อมูลเกม
const DEVICE_MODE_KEY="techQuestDeviceMode";
function applyDeviceMode(mode){
 const safeMode=mode==="desktop"?"desktop":"mobile";
 document.body.classList.toggle("force-desktop",safeMode==="desktop");
 document.body.classList.toggle("force-mobile",safeMode==="mobile");
 const label=document.getElementById("deviceModeLabel");
 const icon=document.getElementById("deviceModeIcon");
 const btn=document.getElementById("deviceModeToggle");
 if(label)label.textContent=safeMode==="desktop"?"โหมดคอมพิวเตอร์":"โหมดมือถือ";
 if(icon)icon.innerHTML=safeMode==="desktop"?'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="4" width="18" height="13" rx="2"/><path d="M8 21h8M12 17v4"/></svg>':'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="7" y="2" width="10" height="20" rx="2"/><path d="M11 18h2"/></svg>';
 if(btn){btn.setAttribute("aria-pressed",String(safeMode==="desktop"));btn.title="คลิกเพื่อเปลี่ยนเป็นโหมด"+(safeMode==="desktop"?"มือถือ":"คอมพิวเตอร์");}
 try{localStorage.setItem(DEVICE_MODE_KEY,safeMode);}catch(e){}
}
function toggleDeviceMode(){
 const next=document.body.classList.contains("force-desktop")?"mobile":"desktop";
 applyDeviceMode(next);
}
(function initDeviceMode(){
 let saved="";try{saved=localStorage.getItem(DEVICE_MODE_KEY)||"";}catch(e){}
 applyDeviceMode(saved==="desktop"?"desktop":"mobile");
})();

</script>
